notes.title: Smoother Sessions Ahead - Performance Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/18553b063b713620838db4d6111a6e8797ecd25f.jpg[/img]

Hey Gas Jockeys!

We’ve rolled out a long-awaited performance improvement. A critical issue that caused the game to slow down over time during extended play sessions has been resolved. Performance should improve for PC players, especially during longer playtimes.

This fix involves correcting NPC navigation and reducing the map's generated paths. The optimization keeps NPC movement quality intact while significantly improving overall performance.

As a result, the game now runs much smoother, and FPS drops after long sessions should no longer appear.

Thank you all for your feedback and reports. We truly appreciate them, and they helped us improve the game’s stability and performance. 

~ Kinia

tags.bug: A critical issue that caused the game to slow down over time during extended play sessions has been resolved.

notes.title: Physics & Popularity Balance Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]New & Improved: 🔧[/h2][/b]

[b]Balance for Custom Gas Prices: [/b]The Custom Gas Prices balance patch fixes gameplay issues where fuel prices led to overly reduced traffic in the early game. Traffic behavior is now more balanced, making the system feel more fair at the beginning of the game. We’ve also made a few UI improvements for clarity and ease of use when managing prices and traffic.
Setting a New Fuel Price should close/open fuel pumps to reset the Traffic
Small changes to the questline in the early game.
Added NPCs to the Tidal Wave Volcano cinematic even if Traffic is very low.

[b]Physics Crash Update:[/b] We’ve fixed a critical physics issue that was causing most of the crashes, especially during high-traffic or object-heavy situations. This particular crash has accounted for about 75% total crashes since the release of the game, so we expect the crash frequency for people who had this particular issue to be reduced significantly.

[b]Other:[/b]
Customers will now generate shopping lists based only on the shelf types currently placed in the shop, ensuring they always have something to buy.

[b][h2]Bug Fixes: 🐛[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Change Fuel Price objective would repeatedly appear after save/load.
[*] Fixed a bug where Streamer Mode did not affect Drive-In Cinema films.
[*] Fixed a bug where popularity traffic impact points were not functioning properly in the Custom Gas Prices system.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could repeatedly sell a barrel from a landmark as an exploit.
[*] Fixed a bug where hanging a painting could block game progression.
[*] Fixed a bug where sandpiles failed to stop cars in front of them.
[*] Fixed various localization issues.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Chinese localization of the Cinema Ticked mini game, where the time of the movie was missing.
[*] Fixed a bug where cars could still struggle to exit the parking lot.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Car Management” UI could be accessed while in the basic inventory.
[*] Fixed a bug where a redundant square plane would appear near the Drive-In Cinema parking when the cinema was closed.
[*] Fixed a bug where price board shaders appeared incorrect when viewed from the back.
[*] Fixed a bug where Tidal Wave customers could become stuck in the shower area.
[*] Fixed a bug where loading a save with a popularity level of 22 would apply a negative popularity factor.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Party Spot tutorial pop-up could not be closed on first appearance.
[*] Fixed a bug where the [Esc] key would not exit the Fuel Price Board UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where Joe could get stuck in the desert sand.
[*] Fixed a bug where the automatic chemical bath was usable without having unlocked the required upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug where closing the Fuel Price Board UI would not automatically close the tutorial overlay.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Fuel Price Board tutorial used an outdated image.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Traffic Meter tutorial in the base game included an outdated image.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Traffic Meter tutorial image was missing in the Tidal Wave UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Traffic tutorial did not disappear after interacting with the Fuel Price Board in Tidal Wave.
[*] Fixed a bug where a gamepad binding glyph appeared in the Junkyard Contracts UI while playing with mouse and keyboard.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could rebind Airbrush Decal Picker and Wrench D-pad buttons and break them.
[*] Fixed a bug in Junkyard Objective 2 where the dollar amount lent to Sean was not displayed in the popup UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Contracts UI in the Junkyard was missing reward amounts in dollars.
[/list]

notes.title: Fuelnomenal Update is Here + New DLC Reveal! 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Today is the day, folks! The Fuelnomenal Update is officially available to download 🔥
I don’t want to take too much of your valuable time, so let’s jump straight into what’s in store for today’s update, shall we? 👇

[h2]What’s New? 🔧[/h2]

[list]
[*] Full Controller Support (Xbox + Steam Input for PlayStation) 🎮 Please keep in mind that gamepad is not supported on MacOS systems. 
[*] Set Your Own Fuel Prices ⛽
[*] Loads of polish, fixes, and smoother gameplay ⚒️
[/list]

Here are the full patch notes for today's update: 

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3]Base Game[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where using "Store All" would delete products when storage was full.
[*] Fixed a bug where cars could park due to workshop and services-bound vehicles.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Paint Roller color palette UI to be cut off at specific screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Portuguese translation for the hammer while the station is open.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs could steal from the player when the customer queue was full.
[*] Fixed a bug where cars parked at cinema parking lots couldn't be picklocked after completing cinema related questline.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Witch’s Hat decoration using the wrong material.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wall painting service was blocked in the Chinese UI due to stretched layout.
[*] Fixed a bug with broken Turkish translations in the shelf product placement UI.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing certain decorations from being removed from door frames.
[*] Fixed a bug causing customers to get stuck in doorways due to wrong collisions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Employee UI had misleading descriptions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Painting tutorial included actions with unbound inputs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the current task could overlap with the Challenges window in the HUD.
[*] Fixed a bug with outdated or missing translations for shelf tooltips.
[*] Fixed a bug where the storage interaction popup was too small.
[*] Fixed a bug where employees would not clean despite being assigned the task as a secondary job.
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect tutorial description in the "Transfer Between Maps" tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug where biker graffiti disappeared after saving and loading the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tutorial for painting had unbound input instructions.
[*] Fixed a bug that after placement of an ice cream shelf under a cigarettes shelf could block NPCs in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug where the spike afro hairstyle had mismatched hair layers on customer NPCs.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rudy did not respawn after using the reset button.
[*] Fixed a bug affecting Rudy's driving behavior and movement properties.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ice Cream Stand UI showed a double order list too small after previously having a single order.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ice Cream order UI remained visible after serving the last customer.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing the ice cream scoop to be released by pressing the spacebar.
[*] Fixed a bug where a visual artifact appeared when taking a cone at the Ice Cream Stand.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ice Cream minigame’s first tip included redundant information.
[*] Fixed a bug where outdated information was shown in the Ice Cream Spot tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ice Cream Stand UI displayed a double order list too small after switching from single orders.
[*] Fixed a bug where the order UI remained active after serving the last ice cream customer.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing the player to release an ice cream scoop with the spacebar.
[*] Fixed a bug where Photo Mode was missing translations in Polish and other languages.
[*] Fixed a bug causing unnecessary scroll space in tutorials.
[*] Fixed a bug where Russian localization in emails displayed "/p" incorrectly.
[*] Fixed various crash reports.
[/list]
[h3]Tidal Wave[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Tidal Wave clocks were categorized as standing instead of hanging decorations.
[*] Fixed a bug where a floating sunbed appeared near the Ice Cream Stand.
[/list]
[h3]Airstrip[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with additional missing Joe event cases.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing multiple blueprint trades during Joe’s first trade by spamming space.
[*] Fixed a bug where employees restocking from the airport storage did not actually consume stored items.
[/list]
[h3]Junkyard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Car Customization tutorial had gamepad input and usability issues.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cancel button behaved inconsistently during the Car Customization tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Car Parts UI "Sort by Car Model" menu shifted position with the main button width.
[*] Fixed a bug where binding hints were missing when operating the Crane with default settings.
[*] Fixed a bug showing outdated images in the Junkyard deliveries tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug with the French translation for the grinding wreck interaction.
[/list]

[h2]Gas Station Simulator – Franchise Sale is live!💲[/h2]

Grab Gas Station Simulator and all existing DLCs at historic low prices. If you’ve been thinking about upgrading your station, this is the perfect moment to do so! Don’t hesitate and check out the sale page by clicking the link below.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/35934053/view/545604485921112299][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/889324d28cecc505e4fe101f8f9df2258c89c639.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]RV Camp DLC announcement – New member in the Gas Station Universe!💥[/h2]

That’s right! In the RV Camp DLC, you take on the role of a campground. Rent out spots to travelers and complete diverse minigames to help them while away the hours. Expand your campsite, tackle various challenges, and help Ruby (the main character of this DLC) create the best resort the world has ever seen. Check the freshly revealed Steam page, and wishlist the DLC now! 🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543920/Gas_Station_Simulator__RV_Camp_DLC/

[h2]But what about the Shady Deals then? 🤔[/h2]

That’s a hell of a good question, and since we want to be fully transparent with you, we’re here to explain the whole situation, cause there are many of you who are eagerly waiting for this DLC. Now, some time ago, we decided that we need to have more hands on board if we want to keep updating Gas Station Simulator with new content and updates while at the same time working on other titles that we have in our portfolio (you know which in particular I have in mind). 

Having said that, we decided to cooperate with an external partner. Unfortunately, the deal didn’t go the way we expected, even despite the goodwill from our partner. It took us some time to realize that this ain’t going into the direction that we’ve always wanted to, and we decided to terminate the contract with this partner. 

So what’s the situation for now? Well, Shady Deals DLC is in our hands again, but first, we decided that we’ll focus our efforts on the just-revealed RV Camp DLC, as this has been in production for a couple of months already and will be released this year. 

Now, I’m fully aware that there will be many of you who will simply be disappointed, and to be honest, I totally get it. It was a really difficult decision for us, and we want to go through this time together with you. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us, we do really appreciate and hope for your understanding of this situation and we do what we can to entertain you Gas Jockeys with all the content being added to the game. 

[url=https://discord.gg/dragoent][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/241fe258372ddb1a36c82e4a35f477bfb1e8f234.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today! Now, go, fellow gas jockeys and enjoy a fresh update to your beloved Gas Station Simulator. Don’t hesitate to leave your comments and share your invaluable feedback in the comments down below. We’ll be monitoring it over the course of the next days and weeks, so keep those comments coming. Until the next devlog! 👋

[i]P.S Today is also a very important day for our friends over Garage Monkeys, as the long-awaited premier of Car Dealer Simulator is today as well. If by any chance you’re looking for a great game where you can become a true car dealer, Car Dealer Simulator should be your cup of tea.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

[i]~Sewek[/i]

notes.title: Let’s Talk About the Controller Support for Gas Station Simulator 🎮
notes.content:
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Welcome to another development update, where we share what we’ve been cooking up for our beloved Gas Station Simulator. Last time, we gave you a sneak peek at dynamic fuel prices — and it looks like many of you are eagerly waiting to get your hands on that feature. If you missed that announcement, feel free to check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620?emclan=103582791465284088&emgid=562497971311083642]here.[/url]

Today, I’m thrilled to finally share some insights into a feature that has been requested since day one: Controller Support for Gas Station Simulator! So, grab your favourite drink, some snacks, and let’s roll! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5a24611b331f567e201dafdafc30d0cae9cb42b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Controller Support Update 🎮[/h2]

I’m gonna say (or rather write) this loud and clear: after countless requests from the community, we’ve finally rolled up our sleeves and implemented full controller support. However, there are a few things you need to know.

[h2]Full Xbox Controller Support ✅[/h2] 

We’ve added full support for Xbox controllers. Whether you're using an Xbox One or Xbox Series X|S controller, Gas Station Simulator now fully supports both. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/67c50d917739a69d8abc57d1e6bbe76b8e5a242f.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Input Support 🎮[/h2] 

We’ve also integrated Steam Input, which means if you're using a PlayStation controller, the game will automatically detect it and adjust the button bindings accordingly. No manual setup required — unless you want to customize your controls, of course!

[h2]What About Other Controllers? ⚠️[/h2] 

While Steam Input brings great flexibility, third-party or non-standard controllers may not be fully supported. You might encounter issues with responsiveness or button mapping. For the smoothest experience, we recommend sticking to Xbox controllers for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c19cd27ffcb1aa2b435a0944e63fc310ffbf7326.jpg[/img]

[h2]We’ll Be Live Streaming the Fuelnomenal Update!👀[/h2] 

Mark your calendars! On [b]May 29th at 6 PM CEST,[/b] we’re going live to celebrate:

[list]
[*] The launch of the Fuelnomenal Update
[*] The long-awaited Controller Support
[*] Our Franchise Sale, also starting that day
[*] And much, much more!
[/list]

We’ll be playing the update live, answering your questions, and maybe even dropping a few surprises 🔥

Catch us on our official Twitch and YouTube channels — make sure to follow us on Twitch and subscribe to our YouTube channel so you don’t miss a thing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/de9a4e3f657f14eec6c9d33fae481f96db2dc6ef.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay Up-To-Date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today! Not gonna lie — excitement levels are off the charts right now, and we can't wait to see your reactions to the upcoming update. Let us know what you think about the new features, and don’t hesitate to share your feedback and suggestions. Have a fantastic day (and weekend!), and we’ll see you all on May 29th, 2025, when the update goes live. Until then, folks!

P.S. Don’t forget — Car Dealer Simulator premieres on May 29th, 2025 too!
If you're ready to become the best car dealer in the world, wishlist it now to get notified as soon as it launches.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

~Sewek

notes.title: New Pretty Characters Update is finally available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/fb151f7eac7cb7f1c55bb08dce4a394b9fd46c18.jpg[/img]

Hey, Gas Jockeys!  

Big news straight from the desert: the New Pretty Characters Update is officially LIVE! 🎉
Yep, it's finally time to say goodbye to some of those, uh... “charmingly outdated” faces passing through your gas station and welcome a fresh new crowd with cleaner models, updated outfits, and more variety than ever before!

These new NPC models don’t just look better – they’re also part of our ongoing quest to optimize the game. Thanks to tech improvements under the hood, we were able to make them both prettier and more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/2ccbf6568951dd3f200f6e8f22215e421538fa75.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned earlier, this update focuses solely on visuals – the behavior of your customers remains unchanged (yes, they will still honk if you leave them waiting too long). But we promise, they’ll look way better doing it now.

[h2]📝 Patch Notes:[/h2] 

[h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2]

[b]Base game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Employee UI was not interactable, as reported by players.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Chinese localization where the timer was missing in the ticket minigame.
[*] Fixed a bug where cars could still have issues leaving parking spots, based on player reports.
[*] Fixed missing sounds on the lottery machine.
[*] Fixed a bug where music would disappear after loading a save during an active sandstorm.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could freeze during lockpicking, as reported by players.
[*] Fixed a bug where a specific row in the Statistics tab was non-functional.
[*] Fixed a bug where Christmas decorations could appear levitating, based on player reports.
[*] Fixed a bug where the road at the gas station entrance required correction.
[*] Fixed a traffic issue where delivery vehicles could still crash with cars coming from the opposite direction at the gas station entrance, as reported by players.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs would stutter on the porch area when entering the gas station building, based on player reports.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs could become blocked at the fuel pumps, as reported by players.
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a game on build 31637s, as reported by a players.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs could not be removed using the reset button.
[*] Fixed an issue in Arabic where objectives with counters showed improper icons instead of numbers.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Drive-In Cinema where the 12-hour clock did not correctly display the end of display hours.
[*] Fixed an issue where the default graphic quality preset was incorrect, it’s was changed from Notebook to High.
[*] Fixed a bug in the PC UI where the red dot marker did not disappear upon changing the questline.
[*] Fixed a UI bug where some elements in the Key Bindings settings were out of bounds.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to drop sand in the Drive-In Cinema zone.
[*] Fixed a bug where cars could still be taken by the UFO during a restart, even if the gas station was empty.
[/list]
[b]Airstrip:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cleaning the barn too early at the AirStrip could block progress in the questline.
[/list]
[b]Tidal Wave:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where music would stop on Tidal Wave when transferring from Route 66 during an active sandstorm.
[/list]
[b]Car Junkyard:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an exploit in the Junkyard where a single contract could be completed multiple times by pressing Enter.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Junkyard where cars could not be moved from the design spot.
[/list]

We're pleased to have prepared this update for you, but we’re even more excited about what’s to come. Our team is hard at work on future updates, and we’ll be sharing more information with you soon. Trust us – we're working on something you really wanted.

Until then, enjoy the new look, keep the shelves stocked, and maybe... sweep the floor once in a while?

Catch you at the pump – and don’t forget to overcharge the tourists! 😉

~ Sewek

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

[i]P.S. Tired of routine jobs? Become a car dealer with questionable morals and even more questionable customers.
Play the [b]Car Dealer Simulator Demo[/b] from our friends at Garage Monkeys.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/44fd49ab64ba59bdc954738b7117e98b94d27fd6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys!⛽ [/h1]

Another day in the job means another bunch of fixes has arrived to your Gas Station Simulator. notes.title: Let's find out when the Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC releases👀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

It’s me again with another development update for Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema! 🚗 In the last episode, we delved into some crucial mechanics in the DLC – the projector, popcorn machine, and Drive-In Cinema’s renown system. If you’re curious to learn more about those, click this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620?emclan=103582791465284088&emgid=631169711261876254]link[/url] and enjoy reading! 🔥

Now, you might be wondering what I have in store for you today. Worry no more—I’m here to answer! Today, I’ll give you insights into the ticket control mini-game and how the Drive-In Cinema cleaning system will work. Additionally, we’ll dive into the nitty-gritty details of some brand-new events that will enhance your cinema experience. And last but not least, I’m thrilled to finally share the release date with you! 🤩 Excited? Then let’s not waste any more time—let’s roll!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b4ae3ace9be51cbcee1ce4ba20f77f985939f9c3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ticket Control 👮[/h2]

Imagine going to the cinema with a fake ticket—what do you think would happen? You’d probably get kicked out, and your chance to watch that long-awaited movie would slip through your fingers. In the Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC, you’ll step into the role of a ticket inspector, ensuring that no sneaky moviegoers try to watch films for free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/49677c8362aab6d1cb144f6e323ad4005d15aac0.gif[/img]

[h2]Cleaning 🧹[/h2]

Just like your gas station and toilets, your Drive-In Cinema needs proper cleaning too! Apart from those pesky customers leaving trash behind, you’ll also sometimes miss your shot at the Dennis dummy, right? At first, it might feel a little tedious—running between your station, toilet, and cinema to keep everything spotless. But don’t worry! As you upgrade your cinema to higher tiers, cleaning will become automated, just like most other systems in this DLC. ⚙️

[h2]Events in Drive-In Cinema 🗓️[/h2]

It wouldn’t be a proper Gas Station Simulator DLC without some exciting events to boost your renown and income, right? Let’s take a look at two new events that will be available alongside the DLC.

[h3]Rush Hour ⌚[/h3]

As the name suggests, a single hour between 10 AM and 10 PM will be randomly selected. This chosen hour will be visible in the projector screen UI, and if you schedule a movie for this time slot, you’ll gain special benefits—such as increased popcorn prices and faster renown growth.

[h3]Trending 📈[/h3]

The Trending event is a special occurrence within the projector, where 1-3 random movies are selected to participate. These movies receive a special tag, making them more visible to you. During the event, ticket prices for these movies increase by 50%, providing a revenue boost.

Important note: All events start at 12 PM and last 24 hours until the next draw.

[h2]Drive-In Cinema is coming in March 2025! 🔥[/h2]

Yep, you read that right! Soon, your beloved gas station will receive a brand-new, free expansion, bringing you exciting new ways to boost your income and popularity. So, make some popcorn, grab your favorite drinks, wrap yourself in a warm blanket, and [b]mark March 6, 2025, in your calendars![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/fd7f83dcc10fd846e0e54e0701fdbad82fdbd327.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s a wrap on another sneak peek into the Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC! There’s still a lot to share, and I can’t wait to reveal what we’ve been working on. Show your excitement in the comments below, and as always, feel free to share any feedback with us.

Last but not least, you can expect another development update next week—where we’ll be talking about… movies! (Maybe even your own? That depends on how many comments this announcement gets! 😉)For now, have a fantastic rest of your day, enjoy your weekend, and I’ll see you in the next devlog! 👋

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/

[i]P.S Oh… Did you know our friends from the world of car dealerships have released Car Dealer Simulator Prologue: Early Days? If negotiating, repairing, and selling vehicles is your cup of tea, then I strongly recommend to check this one out![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

[i]~ Sewek[/i]

notes.title: Let's talk about some key features in Drive-In Cinema DLC🔑
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1] 

It’s time for another development update for our upcoming, brand-new DLC for Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC. Last time we talked about what is Drive-In Cinema DLC and its own employees. If you somehow missed the last announcement, you can freely check it out right now by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/515201205637480519]clicking this link[/url]. 

Today, I want to walk you through some of the structures that are crucial to have a remarkable night in the cinema. That’s obviously a project and a popcorn machine. At the end of the announcement we will also talk a little bit about Drive-In Cinema’s renown, so stick with me till the end. Shall we begin then? 🤩

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/

[h2]The Projector 🎥[/h2]

First things first — every memorable outdoor movie night needs an old, good, and reliable projector. In the Drive-In Cinema DLC, the projector is your go-to tool. Here you can schedule the movies you want to show to your customers from a wide range of those available. You can decide when the showtimes start. Plan your nights around peak traffic hours or align them with special in-game events. Who doesn’t love a midnight horror marathon? 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/65f8e9cc866e5f38b29bc8704ed2d58715a04d54.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Popcorn Machine 🍿[/h2]

No cinema experience is complete without a bucket of hot, buttery popcorn. That’s where the Popcorn Machine comes in! This nifty gadget doesn’t just add to the movie-watching ambiance; it also benefits you and your gas station in a couple of ways:

[list]
[*] Boost Your Gold Income 💰 – Serving popcorn to moviegoers gives you extra revenue. Customers love a tasty snack, so you’ll see a steady increase in profits.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Increase Your Renown 📈 – Providing a great snack is part of delivering an excellent cinema experience. The more satisfied your customers are, the more they’ll spread the word about your drive-in cinema.
[/list]
[list]
[*] More ways to deal with… Dennis! 😃 – That’s right! If you’re tired of that pesky Dennis messing around your station, you can easily turn your frustration into fun! Use the Popcorn Machine to grab a bucket or two and throw them at the Dennis dummy when it appears. It might just be the ultimate stress reliever or simply hilarious moment for you 🔥
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/60546e329e48d0da3e65f6df6d9d98ca486d282a.png[/img]

[h2]Renown 🤩[/h2]

In this DLC, your new Drive-In Cinema has its very own Renown mechanic. Think of it like a progress bar that reflects how popular your drive-in theater is. Every time a customer drives in to watch a movie (and hopefully buy some popcorn), your renown ticks up. The higher the renown, the better upgrades you’ll be able to unlock. 

From improved projector settings which allows you to schedule more movies in advance, or an automatic tool that will help you keep the cinema clean – the more you invest in your drive-in cinema experience, the more it’ll pay off in both satisfaction and sweet, sweet profits.

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s a wrap for our another sneak peek into the Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC! We can’t wait to hear what you think about the projector, the popcorn machine, and the new renown system. Your feedback helps us refine the experience and make the Gas Station Simulator as enjoyable as possible. Let us know in the comments which features you’re most excited for and what you’d love to see next. Until the next devlog! 👋

[i]P.S Looking for some great ways to combine business with pleasure? Together with Garage Monkeys we've got you covered. Check out the Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue and see if you've got what it takes to become the number one car dealer in the world.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

~Sewek

notes.title: All the ins and outs of Drive-In Cinema DLC 🎥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to another development update where I’m showing you what we’ve been cooking up for your beloved Gas Station Simulator. I’m so delighted to see that the recent Restocking Shelves Update has met your expectations (for most of you at least). On behalf of the entire DRAGO entertainment team, I’d like to really thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all of the amazing comments that we’ve received. ❤️

Now, on the main topic. I’m fully aware that it’s been a while since our announcement of Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC. Moreover, we haven’t revealed much information about it so far, apart from releasing the Steam Page. But… Today we’re finally able to share some insights from the Drive-In Cinema DLC. We might even have a little tease regarding the release date, so stick with me till the end of this announcement. For now, let’s grab a favourite drink of yours, cover yourself with a warm blanket to create a cozy atmosphere, and let’s roll 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/57084698022739233017741beb5e38f1aa9e750f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is Drive-In Cinema DLC? 🤔[/h2]

The Drive-In Cinema DLC is a brand-new, free of charge addition to the Gas Station Simulator that brings extra revenue streams and possibility of further expansion. Your main goal? Acquiring additional space and setting up a drive-in theater complete with a modern projector and a giant screen. 

When all is set and one, it’s high time to introduce the cinema to your demanding clientele. Validate tickets, manage sneaky customers trying to get in for free, and invest in further upgrades like a popcorn machine to provide a complete movie-going experience. Grow your renown in order to attract more customers and expand your clientele. All of this coming soon for free! Oh… You may even use the popcorn to throw at Dennis, but more on that in the future announcements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f3275fd6de83b241bb93f54ae7bb681a886c373b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Will Drive-In Cinema have its own employees? 🧑‍🏭[/h2]

The answer is – yes, but actually no. At the beginning the goal of the DLC is to give you complete control over what’s happening in the drive-in cinema. However, as you grow your renown (yes, drive-in cinema will have its own renown) you’ll be able to purchase more upgrades that will automate most of the activities there (well… You still need to use a popcorn machine to fend off Dennis right?). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/47dd0b6b500a14ed9d807e15e2b91af867a90b53.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join us on a live stream next week 💥[/h2]

That’s right! We’ll be live streaming next Tuesday, 11th of February at 6 p.m CET. We’ll be talking about Drive-In Cinema DLC, answering your most common questions (about consoles and other games that are in development as well), and chilling while playing our beloved Gas Station Simulator. The stream will take place on our official twitch.tv channel, so don’t forget to follow us if you don’t want to miss the stream 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b53a8ddf534229d14f381522c4c1c34b3b5ac21e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2] 

So, that’s gonna be it for today’s announcement. Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below. As always, I’m more than happy to hear your feedback regarding projects that we’re working on. You can expect the next announcement coming next week in which I’ll be talking about how the projector, popcorn machine and the Drive-In Cinema renown works. Last but not least, if you want to stay in the loop of everything Gas Station Sim, consider adding Drive-In Cinema to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/?l=polish

[i]P.S. Ever wondered what it’s like to run your own car dealership? Car Dealer Simulator Prologue from our friends at Garage Monkeys lets you step into the world of buying, selling, and negotiating deals! [/i]

notes.title: Restocking Shelves Update is Available Now 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/019089ca6cf631a8366d5e94444f6b97459c5410.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽ [/h1]

I’m more than thrilled to announce that the Restocking Shelves Update is finally available for you to download. Make sure to update the game and while you wait, let’s dive right into what’s in store for you this time around 🤩

Yeap, you hear that right! From now on, your employees will finally have the possibility to restock those empty shelves and do the tedious work for you. Of course it’s totally up to you – you can still do it by yourself, but if you feel like you need some well-deserved rest, you can freely assign this task to one of your employees. If you want to see how it looks in the game, make sure to head over to our previous announcement 

Oh… And along with the update, our team has managed to fix some of the issues you’ve reported previously. Check the full patch notes below and let us know in the comments down below what you think 👇

[h2]Changes🔄[/h2]

[list]
[*] Automatic Restocking: now you can use your Employees to restock your Shelves. You can pick between automatic restocking and custom set up which allows you to control which products are restocked and when. We also reworked the mechanic of picking up shelves. 
[*] Challenges Rework: Challenges have been balanced in the Base Game and Tidal Wave. In TW, they contribute to reducing the volcano’s anger. For the ones already present in the Base Game, We’ve added two new challenges related to refueling boats. 
[*] In the Base Game, challenges have been modified based on the popularity level – up to level 8, challenges require fewer customers to be served and offer smaller rewards in terms of popularity points. After level 8, challenges require serving more customers but grant more popularity points.
[*] Show/Hide HUD: we added another Display Option that allows the player to hide HUD.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes⚒️[/h2]
[h3]Base game⛽[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where 12 PM was displayed as 12 AM
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed player to place cigarettes shelves twice on the same slot after loading the game
[*] Fixed a FPS drop when Party Bus arrives at the Station
[*] Fixed a bug that required player to click on screen first in order to be able to skip cutscene
[*] Fixed a visual bug with wrong material on Fuel Delivery outflow that made it too dark
[*] Fixed a bug that caused blocking a fixed car on the Workshop lift after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a bug that showed picklocking challenge during the last cinematic
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a player to be stuck in sewers
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a player to coles Shelve UI with pressing any button
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Tobacco products to be hard to target on Shelves
[*] Fixed a landscape hole near the Workshop
[*] Fixed a visual bug that prevented some parts of the Workshop from loading properly on Notebook graphic setting
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented player from opening Tool menu pressing Tab
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped music when player entered Rudy
[*] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of Management Tab in 3440x1440 resolution
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Party Bus customers to be blocked by Police Car waiting for Fuel
[*] Fixed a bug that caused both levels of Christmas decorations to be displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed missing localization for Hammer tool and new Cash Register
[*] Fixed a bug that caused display of wrong Cash Register model after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect font for Party Time Timer in Polish version of the game
[*] Fixed a bug that caused employees to get stuck in car wash ruins
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a game to crash when player went back to washing car after popularity cutscene
[*] Fixed a various problems with spawning Employees 
[/list]


[h3]Tidal Wave🏝️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed player to set up multiple queues to the Cash Register
[*] Fixed a bug that caused music to stop when using PC management tab
[*] Fixed a visual bug with missing lighting at the entrance of the Level 8 Gas Station
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Workshop lights to get turned off i player exited the Workshop holding Shift
[*] Replaced a wrong picture for Lvl 1 Car Wash in Upgrade Tree
[*] Removed redundant stone that appeared only on High Graphic setting
[/list] 


[h3]Airstrip✈️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Joe’s crash site spawning above the map.
[*] Fixed a visual bug with incorrect placement of the hats on the hanger
[*] Fixed a visual bug with disappearing smoke from Joe’s plane
[*] Fixed a bug that significantly reduced chances for success after a failed trade
[*] Fixed a bug that started Sandstorms before the first trade
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Joe to have incorrect position on bench after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Joe’s plane to smoke even after towing it to hangar
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Junkyard⚙️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that changed quest to Junkyard questline after loading the game
[*] Fixed a bug that showed Car Wreck UI during the cutscenes
[*] Fixed incorrect description in Square Lvl 4 Upgrade
[*] Fixed a bug that caused to show incorrect “Money Lost” value after a failed delivery
[*] Removed redundant Projectors tutorial
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

We hope this update enhances your Gas Station Simulator experience and helps you keep those shelves looking spick and span. As always, thank you for your continued support, and be sure to let us know your thoughts. Until the next devlog! 

[i]~Sewek[/i]

[i]P.S Our friends over Garage Monkeys wanted us to share that Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue just had its release. The free introduction to the base game allows you to get your hands-on the core mechanics of the game, so if you’re looking for something to pass the time over the weekend, feel free to check it out. [/i]

notes.content:

[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to the first announcement of 2025! I hope you had an amazing time during the Christmas break and you’ve celebrated New Year with a blast 💥But worry no more if you’ve had a rather peaceful time – I’m gonna do my best to get you in the proper mood, cause the news I bring today are definitely from the jaw-dropping category, as we finally know when the long-awaited feature is gonna be available in our beloved Gas Station Simulator 👀Let the games begin then! 🔥

[h2]Restocking Shelves Update will be available next week 🥳[/h2]

That’s right! Your employees will finally be able to restock the shelves for you some time next week. I know there are many of you who have been eagerly waiting to get your hands-on restocking shelves by employees, so I’m more than thrilled to bring it to you. Now, I won't leave you without anything spicy, so what about a little sneak peek into the restocking shelves and how it looks right now, shall we?

The way it works is quite simple – first of all, make sure to assign the "Restocking Shelves" task to one of your employees. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/7c550b1d12e5549a97f5cbe3c90b0aa47ee54778.gif[/img]

Last thing you need to do is to choose whether you want to customize the amount of products that's gonna be on the shelve, or you want to let the employee restock it randomly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/9ef5166a1da95252408391d235878c79af33dd88.gif[/img]

And job's done! You can now sit and relax while your employees will do the dirty work for you.

If you have any questions, issues, or simply want to chat with us, don’t hesitate and head over to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drago_entertainment]official twitch.tv channel[/url]. I’m expecting as many of you as possible, so don’t disappoint me 🙇

Unfortunately, all good things must come to an end. Let me know in the comments down below how many of you cannot wait for the restocking shelves update. We'll be still working tirelessly to make the update as best as possible and we'll hear each other once again in the next week. Until the next devlog!

notes.title: Last update of the year and some important information about the DLCs🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to the probably last announcement in 2024. It’s hard to believe that we’re already a couple of days away from the end of 2024. It feels like yesterday we announced the Economy Update or Car Junkyard DLC, but time flies as the saying goes. 

Today, I thought it’s gonna be the perfect time to talk about both the present and the future for your favorite – Gas Station Simulator. I’m gonna share some information regarding the [b]upcoming updates, DLCs (Shady Deals included), and more[/b]. So, grab a drink and snack of your choice, and let’s roll 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/57d401c3b6f65d6c00c5c583e12f58b3f1602864.jpg[/img]

[h2]Another batch of visual improvements has landed on Route 66 👀[/h2]

Let’s kick things off with a little update for the Gas Station Simulator. Some time ago, we did a whole performance and visual revamp for the GSS, but some of the models were still left unchanged simply because they were still a little bit rough around the edges and we needed some additional time to polish them. Fortunately, you don’t have to wait much longer as the update is already available on Steam. Along with that, the cash register also went through some changes mainly introducing some brand-new customization options. 

And yes – we remember about the ability to restock shelves by the employees. We’re already working on it, but we want to emphasize proper balancing before releasing it to you, hence some additional time is needed. 

[h2]Changes♻️[/h2]

[h3]Base game⛽[/h3]

[list]
[*] Increased distance between Car Parts Truck and other cars to improve traffic.
[*] Cash Register Upgrade: now you can upgrade the cash register on higher leves of Gas Station. You can also customize its colors on the higher levels.
[*] Products Revamp: We reworked all products, increased quality of topology and textures
[*] Shelves Revamp: New design and quality bar for shelves of all products.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes🐛[/h2]

[h3]Base game⛽[/h3]

[list]
[*] Epic settings have been merged into High settings. We removed the Epic setting as it became redundant after the Revamp.
[*] Fixed a lag after opening tutorials on PC.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed a player to reach the Dead Zone with an RC car around checkpoint 7.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Employees from getting XP from cleaning.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused music to be muted after Biker Guy beating cinematic
[*] Fixed various issues with traffic mostly related to problems with the environment.
[*] Fixed bug that stops music after leveling up the Station.
[*] Fixed bug with traffices caused by cars trying to leave the station with entrance.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Party Bus customers to be blocked at the bus entry.
[*] Fixed a bug with cars spawning in strange positions after loading the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused employees to be stuck in Car Wash ruins in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to pick up shelves with tools equipped. 
[*] Fixed a bug with collisions on some cacti.
[/list]

[h3]Tidal Wave🏝️[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug with music missing after loading the game.
[*] Fixed a traffic issue where new cars had problems with turning right.
[*] Fixed a traffic issue where combi cars could be stuck near the Station entrance.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused music to break after loading save with Party Boat on the map.
[*] Fixed a bug that could break music when starting the electricity generator.
[/list]
	
[h3]Airstrip✈️[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Joe’s crash site spawning above the map.
[*] Fixed a bug that let players spawn Joel after the Marshal Wand mini-game.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Joe to disappear from the plane.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get double Joe after second landing.
[*] Fixed a bug that could stop music after skipping Airstrip upgrade cinematic.
[/list]
	
[h3]Junkyard⚙️[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented a player from completing the “Earn 25000$” objective after a sale.
[/list]

[h2]Drive-In Cinema is coming in Q1, 2025🚗[/h2]

Now let's talk about the release date for our upcoming DLCs. After careful consideration we [b]decided to postpone the release of Drive-In Cinema DLC to Q1, 2025[/b]. We want to use this additional time to work on some extra features, expand the DLC further, and focus on polishing the stuff that we already have prepared. Sincere apologies and I’m more than open to read your comments down below. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/

[h2]What about Shady Deals 🍺?[/h2]

Similar to Drive-In Cinema DLC, we’ll be pushing forward the release date of Shady Deals. As this is a more story-focused DLC for the Gas Station Simulator, it requires much more attention than any other DLC that we’ve made so far. 

Do you have any estimates - you might ask, and honestly you have all the rights to do so. [b]However, with the current state, we can’t share anything apart from coming soon[/b]. We simply don’t want to throw any dates until we have the quality that we’re happy with. As soon as that time comes, I’ll be thrilled to reveal more about the Shady Deals, including its release date. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992100/Gas_Station_Simulator__Shady_Deals_DLC/

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s gonna be it for today’s announcement. I’m more than open to hearing your feedback and thoughts regarding the update and the release dates for the DLCs. Don’t forget that every cloud has a silver lining, and I can say that we have more than one ace up in our sleeves. 

Last but not least, as this is (probably) our last announcement before the Christmas break and New Year, on behalf of the entire DRAGO entertainment team, I’d like to wish you a Merry Christmas (or Happy Holidays) and a Happy New Year! May this time be filled with joy, love, and the presence of your loved ones around you. Charge up your batteries and welcome the new year with a blast. Here is for even greater 2025 🍺Until the next devlog! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/46bb956b662ea0481ea1bfcb4135e50e2c91be94.jpg[/img]

And so, at the very end, I toss you the Car Dealer Simulator from Garage Monkeys, whose release is already approaching in the coming year

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

~Sewek

notes.title: Much-anticipated Revamp Update is available now! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Excitement is off the charts right now as the long-awaited day has finally come. I’m thrilled to bring you the much-anticipated Revamp Update which heavily enhances the look and feel of the game. The update features a [b]plethora of visual improvements, huge changes to the performance[/b] (with a notebook graphic settings on top of that), balance to the Car Junkyard DLC’s contracts, and much, much more! 

We’ve put together a handy trailer for your convenience which perfectly showcases some of the changes coming with this update, so sit tight, relax, and enjoy! 👇

[previewyoutube=VBh2VD2NaNg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Bugfixes🐛[/h1]

Revamp Update also introduces a bunch of fixes to the base game as well as the DLCs, so make sure to check the full patch notes below, so you’re well prepared to take your gas station business to new heights. [b]Important note for all of the Mac users[/b] – we still need some additional time to polish the update for Mac as it's still a little bit rough around the edges. As soon as I know any estimates from the production team, I'll let you know.

[h2]Base game:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievements acquired in Offline mode will now be correctly obtained on Steam after swapping to Online mode
[*] Some strange planes were removed
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Dennis's decals to be removed if the wall was painted from the inside
[*] Some outline interaction issues were resolved
[*] Some issues related to VIP - Employee relations were fixed
[*] Party Bus driver now correctly waits for all customers, to go back to the bus, after a game load
[*] Some missing sounds were added
[*] Some issues related to Employees not starting their jobs were resolved
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from picking up Garbage when loading old Saves.
[*] Fixed a misleading button in the Lottery machine that showed “Cancel” instead of “Return”
[*] Fixed bug that displayed “Car Wash” in two Gas Station Upgrades
[*] Fixed bug with Challenges window blocking other UI elements
[*] Remove the broken lockpick counter in the lockpick tutorial
[*] Fixed various UI bugs with overlapping text and text alignment
[*] Fixed bug with glitchy NPC, in some cases they could have disconnected limbs
[*] Fixed bug with Party Bus customers getting out on wrong angles and clipping through the bus
[*] We fixed various instances of blinking environment elements
[*] We fixed the bad position of the close/open station button in the Management Tab for all screen resolutions
[*] Fixed FPS dropped caused by Party lights
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause you to buy Landmark by clicking the right “Next” arrow
[*] Removed various instances of invisible trash items
[*] Fixed a bug that could get you stuck on the ‘Serve a Customer” objective
[*] Fixed bug that prevented you from picking colors on Paint roller after switching to wallpapers
[*] Added Tidal Wave decorations to the selection in Base Game
[*] Fixed bug that caused Rudy to get stuck on the Sewer manhole
[*] Removed unnecessary “Text Block” phrases in various places
[*] Fixed FPS drop during Sandstorm
[*] Fixed a bug with an incorrect camera angle on some Landmarks (Car Needle and Teepe)
[*] Fixed bug that allowed you to unlock Level 2 of Square too early (this time for real)
[*] Fixed a bug when during the Uncle cinematic cars could break the scene in some cases
[*] Various minor fixes in Localizations
[/list]
[h2]Party Time:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dino Ranch landmarks now have a correct dependency in the Landmarks view
[*] Party Spot buses now have an easier way to departure
[/list]
[h2]Airstrip:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue related to Joe Plane not spawning, after a game load, was resolved
[*] Joe now has a correct position on the bench after loading a save
[*] Fixed bug with broken propeller animation after loading the game
[*] Fixed the bug with Joe getting stuck in the airplane, which could prevent you from completing the tutorial
[/list]
[h2]Tidal Wave:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Employee houses no longer have a missing roof
[*] Some elements of Fuel Delivery UI were adjusted
[*] Some issues related to party music were addressed
[*] Some missing sounds were added
[*] Texture issues related to boats getting too dark were resolved
[*] Fixed a bug that caused traffic jams when cars from the Workshop tried to join the main road
[*] Fixed bug with outlined object being visible through other objects and walls
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause employees to get stuck when changing tasks in the Ice Cream spot
[*] Fixed a FPS drop during the Tidal Wave event
[*] Corrected the Death notifications to improve readability
[*] Fixed various issues with upgrades done via the Home Tab, now it’s always unblocked when conditions are met and works without a lag
[/list]

[h2]Car Junkyard:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sean will no longer get into his car if he is assigned a task in some scenarios
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Sean from crushing a wreck in some scenarios
[*] Junkyard shortcut is no longer visible at the start of the game
[*] Tow Truck drivers now have the correct position
[*] Tow Trucks now have the correct texture on windows
[*] Fixed a bug with wheels disappearing during customization
[*] Fixed a bug that could get Sean stuck in his office
[*] Fixed rock mesh inside of the Crane cabin
[*] Fixed bug that allowed you to pass the Wrench minigame without hitting the orange zone
[/list]

[h1]Changes⚙️[/h1]

Apart from dozens of fixes as you can see above, we've also introduced a variety of different changes to the both base game and DLCs. 

[h2]Base game:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We added a Bug Reporting Tool to help you let us know about problems with the game
[*] Support for Ultra Wide monitors was added
[*] We moved Junkyard teleport to the new spot for better usability
[*] We added a pop-up informing you about the occupied fuel pump when an employee takes it
[*] We added additional information about active bonuses to the Bonus Pop-Up
[*] We added some objects to help you reach higher places when repainting the Warehouse
[*] We added an option for a few cars to wait in line at the fuel dispenser 
[*] We made all the objects in the upstairs of the Warehouse intractable, so now you can clean it
[*] Now you can remove products from Shelves without opening the UI
[*] Improved visuals of removing sand piles, now you’ll remove a portion of the sand each time
[*] Added option to disable the Cash Register sound
[*] Added 12-hour time format as an option
[*] We moved the “Continue” button above the “New Game” button, so it’s harder to start the game by accident
[*] Added Junkyard Cars to the Base Game
[*] Added information about reaching the maximum level of a building
[/list]
[h2]Tidal Wave:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option to disable Shark
[/list]
[h2]Car Junkyard:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prices of car wrecks were changed
[*] Customization bonus now is calculated differently
[*] Amount of contracts points gained was increased
[*] Three new contract types were added aiming to utilize lower-tier parts
[*] The economy widget was extended to include Car Junkyard incomes/expenses
[*] Junkyard Inventory: sorting by Tier also sorts by name
[*] Added a protection for driver to not fail delivery too many times in a row
[*] The car rim size was changed to decrease the number of them - you can still select the size while in the design view
[*] Car Stats gears now round up instead of down
[*] The way car price and investor share is displayed was changed to make it easier to understand
[*] QoL changes for failed Sales were added to improve the ability to put sales on the same car faster
[*] Car on Exhibition spot now display if it is put on Sale
[*] Recent colors were added to the Decals view in the design
[*] Contracts now show if the required part is already in storage
[*] Non-customizable wrecks now also bring some universal parts
[*] It is now possible to navigate using A/D through cars while making a sale
[*] We added the ability to sort parts in design mode by their first and alphabetically
[*] We added extra information to the contract completion screen like Car Price or Investor Share
[*] Added extra animations to Fame Tab
[*] Added new progress bar to the Fame Tab
[/list]
[h1]Patch Notes for Revamp🚀[/h1] 
The goal of the revamp was to fix all the visual defects that had been bothering us for a long time and thus refresh the look and mood of the game. At the same time, we took care of the original feeling of our title. We wanted to make something the same. We just wanted to have our game stay the same but better:) To do that we decided to do a complete rework of a Couple of features:

[h3]Foliage[/h3]
The goal here was to eliminate the unnecessary optimizations we had made in the past and restore the original quality of grasses, cactuses, and all the props that make up a large part of what you see on the monitor.

[h3]Landscape[/h3]
Close-up quality, getting rid of obvious glitches and artifacts. Retaining the color palette and adding features at higher scalability levels

[h3]Rocks[/h3]
We completely replaced every rock in the game. Again, taking care of the color palette, we added and reworked channels to fully use computing power.

[h3]Global colors of the project[/h3]
To the best of our abilities, we went over the entire project, adjusting the colors of the models not only to the color palette of the rest of the game but also to Physically accurate standards of the modern gaming rendering pipeline. This enabled us to bring the details to the places in the game that were previously lacking.

[h3]New Lighting and Color grading[/h3]
The changes were very delicately executed. As mentioned previously. We wanted to retain the original feeling and make things look better at the same time. The point of reference was 12.00. This is traditionally the least appealing hour for many reasons. We worked hard to enhance the world at this very hour because we knew the 17.00 will look sweet anyway:)

[h1]Optimization Patch notes📈[/h1]

We tested and focused mainly on older machines. However, we provided a significant performance boost for all graphics settings.

[h2]New Graphic setting[/h2]

The goal was to optimize the game to the point that it would enable it to run comfortably on a PC with integrated GPU (without dedicated GPU). We created a new graphic setting that is situated below the LOW scalability setting. It is dedicated mainly to common business notebook machines that were never prepared to run games in the first place.

GTX 960, which was our minimum spec GPU prepared to run the game on LOW scalability settings, now runs the High scalability settings at about 30 FPS. If the performance is your priority you are free to play around with the scalability setting to find something that runs well and has visual fidelity of your liking.

Removed unbound Lock FPS settings: The new Max is 240.

Epic settings have been merged into High settings. That being said we decided to remove Epic settings as it became unnecessary.

[h2]Among other things reworked we focused on the following:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked outline selection method
[*] Reworked landscape texturing method, implementation, and features
[*] Reflection capture method
[*] Brought quality Materials on all props to work properly with graphic settings
[*] Reworked Sky
[*] Reduced shader complexity for many shaders
[*] Reworked mount Urulu
[*] Numerous other performance improvements
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

So, there you have it! Don’t forget to share your feedback with us below or on our official discord server. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts regarding the update. Last but not least, if you encounter any issues or weird stuff in the game, send us a ticket to support@drago-entertainment.com or use our new tool - Bug Reporter. 

Until the next devlog! 

[i]~Sewek[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45406/Station__Wrecks/

In the meantime, keep an eye out for Car Dealer Simulator from our friends at Garage Monkeys as they've announced a prologue for December, so it's just around the corner.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Let's talk about Gas Station Simulator's Road Map👀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Throughout the year and many Steam announcements that we’ve posted so far, we couldn’t emphasize enough the importance of your support and feedback. Since the Gas Station Simulator launch day we’ve always had in mind the invaluable community that is willing to help us shape the future of not only GSS, but also our other projects including Road Diner Simulator or Motel Simulator. 

We did our best to bring you much anticipated updates including [b]Employee Update or Economy Update[/b] but also some new content in the form of the DLCs. However, we’re still fully aware that there are many features that haven’t found their way into Route 66 yet (yes, I’m talking about restocking shelves or gamepad support for example). But, things are about to change – and I totally understand that rather than empty words you folks would rather see some action going on. And that’s exactly what we plan to do till the end of the year starting with the long-awaited Road Map 🗺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/cddf20411b14972e2269e9e754b68fd30abff5e3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Road Map till the end of 2024👀[/h2]

Before I’m gonna show you the road map there are two things that need further clarification. Firstly, we didn’t include any specific dates in the Road Map simply because we don’t want to give you any promises and later on, due to some unexpected issues, don’t stick to it. In general the plan is simple: As soon as we’re happy with the quality we’ve achieved, we’ll update the game with new features and obviously will share this information with awesome folks from our community. We’ve learnt our lesson from our previous updates and announcements, and we want to avoid any form of disappointment from your side. 

Secondly, you might be thinking – [b]why is the Road Map till the end of 2024 only?[/b] Well, that’s a good question and here I come to give you an answer. In general we have a plethora of things in our mind that we want to bring to table. The hardest part in fact is to prioritize them and put them into the schedule, so everyone knows what goes where and why. I’ll make sure to keep you updated and as soon as we’re ready to reveal what’s coming in 2025, we’ll definitely do that. Now, finally it’s time to share with you our brand-new Road Map. Enjoy and let me know what you think in the comments down below 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/2f1215725c2cfd95702612bc4b6b4cc64dcd47e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]First update is just around the corner 🤫[/h2]

Before we finish this announcement, let’s talk a little bit about the [b]upcoming update[/b], shall we? First and foremost, the production team has done a tremendous amount of work when it comes to [b]improving both visuals and performance of Gas Station Simulator[/b] which is something that have been heavily requested. All I can say right now is that you can expect a new level of graphic scalability that basically is aimed for PCs with integrated GPU. Obviously, that’s just one thing among many, but more on that in the future announcements. Apart from that, you can expect some balance to Car Junkyard DLC (mostly regarding contracts), and much, much more, so stay tuned!

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

Phew…We’ve made it till the end. I hope you’ve enjoyed this little sneak peak of what’s coming to the Gas Station Simulator. It brings me joy when I think about how many things we’ve covered today, yet there is still so much more to talk about. Rest assured, we’re still looking at your comments, suggestions, and ideas, so don’t hesitate and keep those comments coming. Together we will shape the better future for the Gas Station Simulator. Have a wonderful rest of your day, play some fantastic games, and we will see each other in the next devlog. 

[i]P.S Our friends over Codebusters have just released a fresh Family Land: Prologue Steam page, so I though it would be worth to share this information with you. Any farmers wanna be here?[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185480/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator_Prologue/

[i]~Sewek[/i]

notes.title: The gates are open – Gas Station Simulator Car Junkyard DLC is available now!🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys!⛽[/h1]

Not gonna lie – excitement is off the charts right now. After countless hours of hard work, I’m finally able to say that Gas Station Simulator – Car Junkyard DLC is available now on PC! Check out our brand-new spicy launch trailer to celebrate the release and build your junkyard from the scratch 👇

[previewyoutube=y-7D7RncG3k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Base Game Update[/h2]

With the release of Car Junkyard DLC we've also prepared a little update for the base game as well. You can check what's new in the patch notes below. 

[list]
[*] Color balancing and visual smoothness were improved
[*] Multiple optimizations of the Landscape Material resulting in overall performance improvement especially on an older PCs
[*] Bug related to customers trying to park on a one parking spot was fixed
[/list]

Also, quick information for all of the Mac users – you can expect a working build in the upcoming days as well. We've run into some issues due to the updated iOS system, but we're working tirelessly to bring you an update as soon as possible. 

[h2]Everything you need to know about CJ DLC 🧠[/h2]

For those of you who are still not familiar with the whole concept of the DLC, we’ve prepared a handy cheat sheet for your reference. In short, the DLC is all about renovating some rusty, broken cars, customizing them the way you like, and selling them for a profit. If you’re familiar with a “Pimp My Ride” show back in the days, that’s definitely a great comparison. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c77eecea7268024a3edb5706686c7ceba6b31a87.png[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

I won’t bother you much longer, since most of you probably can’t wait to dive into the junkyard business, but before you go, I wanted to let you know that we’re so thankful for your feedback and regular comments. Now, after the Junkyard DLC release it’s a perfect time for us to sit down, carefully analyze your feedback and some of the pesky issues that you’ve been experiencing since the release, and prioritize those, who interrupt your gameplay experience the most. Keep an eye out for the updates, announcements, and news from our side. Until the next devlog!

notes.title: Community Announcement & Release Agenda
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b9bb0199da6c050d161053f56b30283a344818af.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]We would like to address the topic of issues and bugs in the game. [/b][/h2]

Some of you have been quite vocal about it and we do agree with you, more needs to be done. It’s something we were well aware of for a long time and did a lot to deal with it, but the problem is always the same: it’s extremely time consuming and difficult to fix bugs that we do not encounter and/or are unable to reproduce. 

Here we rely mostly on the saved games sent to us. While in many cases it allows us to find the bug and usually reproduce the situation the player has encountered, analyzing saved games is a lengthy process and does not always end with success. This in turn means bug fixing is going very slowly.

[h3][b]Crash & Bug Reporting Tool[/b][/h3]

We have recently introduced a crash reporting tool in our studio, and have been improving it since then and we reached a very satisfying state that will be patched into the base game together with a new in-game bug reporting tool shortly after the release of the Car Junkyard DLC. Whenever you report an issue then, we get a pretty precise “where” and “when” in the code of the game, speeding up bug finding immensely.
On top of that we will also be able to collect crash and bug report data and have the system show us how often these occur in order to prioritize which ones affect the most players and deal with those issues first.

[h3][b]Gas Station Simulator Team[/b][/h3]

When it comes to the people working on Gas Station Simulator, there is something you should know: the team is divided into two sub-teams. One creating the paid DLCs and the other handling the base game only - this means updates, bug fixes and free DLCs. Going forward, we are moving some people around to strengthen the base game team, allowing for more developers to work on fixing bugs and issues as well as speed up the implementation of improvements. Having taken so long to implement certain improvements like grid snapping was a bit embarrassing, even we have to admit that.

[h3][b]Gas Station Simulator and Road Diner Simulator[/b][/h3]

Since we are mentioning teams, Road Diner is not being developed by the Gas Station Simulator team. It has its own development team that while, for obvious reasons, working closely with the GSS team, they are not involved in the base game nor DLCs. So Road Diner’s development is not impacted by whatever is going on in Gas Station Simulator. 

DRAGO Team

notes.title: Learn more about Chemical Bath 🧪and car parts in Car Junkyard DLC 🚗
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to another Gas Station Simulator - Car Junkyard DLC development sneak peek. Today, I’m excited to share some more information about car parts ⚙️ (assembling and disassembling them, how you can make some profit, etc.) as well as the Chemical Bath which is gonna be another spanking new structure that will be introduced with the DLC. Ready to jump in? 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e541d4c70bca1ea772ea8d7b99f6d7f94a7262cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Chemical Bath ⚗️[/h2]
The Chemical Bath is a brand-new structure crucial for the proper functioning of your junkyard. Designed to wash car parts and prepare them for assembly onto freshly prepared wrecks, it's an essential feature that will allow you to restore some rusty car parts that you find while progressing through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8e23c523551b94c3d4cf0c14cec1a6d67a6d36e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Chemical Bath Management 📦[/h2]
Chemicals are vital for efficient cleaning. The more concentration, the more efficient the cleaning process is. As you’ve probably guessed, as soon as the concentration drops to 0%, the cleaning process stops. In order to restart the process, you need to first restore the concentration to 100%. Have a quick look at how it looks currently in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/1e2ef49f95e4775c793dd20246cef1c94912aba9.gif[/img]
[h2]Car Parts Overview ⚙️[/h2] 

Car parts play a crucial role in the Car Junkyard DLC. They are obtained from wrecks delivered to the junkyard, and they can used to build a brand-new vehicle. Car Parts can be separated into two categories 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c34e9d3548d4b1672987b4b86630ab5fd9d27661.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Dedicated Parts: Includes front and rear bumpers, left and right doors, and the hood. These are essential for car customization and they only fit particular car models.
[*] Universal Parts: Includes rims, spoilers, exhausts, mirrors, engines, and turbos. These parts can be used across different car models.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ed0aafbd00a9e749dcf3ce7da34b18ae100ef3b6.gif[/img]

Each car part has its own tag indicating which particular requirement (performance or design) it will affect. As you’ve probably already guessed, parts with a performance tag will impact stats such as acceleration, top speed, handling, etc. On the other hand, the ones with a design tag will only impact the car's visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f7f6d7e490dcddc0cfbcab11e9a2f7dbc3f363b4.gif[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

Unfortunately, all good things must come to an end, gas jockeys 😥So, before we finish, let us know in the comment section down below what you think about the idea of chemical bath and car parts. How do you like some spanking new tools that are on their way to Car Junkyard DLC? The more feedback we collect, the better the DLC will be, I promise. Keep those comments coming, and I’ll do my best to answer them. Last but not least, follow us on social media, and add Car Junkyard DLC to your wishlist if you want to stay in the loop of everything Gas Station Sim. Until the next devlog!

notes.title: Transfering between DLCs 🔄, VIP update 🕵️, and Car Junkyard DLC release date.
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys ⛽[/h1]

Exciting news ahead – today we’re thrilled to share the release date for the upcoming Car Junkyard DLC. If you think that’s all then allow me to surprise ya all. Gas Station Simulator has received a brand-new content update which brings a new type of your one-of-a-kind clientele. Anyway, we have a lot to cover in this announcement, so let’s not beat around the bush and start with a spicy Gas Station Simulator – Car Junkyard DLC trailer 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/61197500b5334857d076bbb44c42c6b0ef82a9d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Car Junkyard DLC teaser and the release date 👀[/h2]

Sean, a daydreamer with muscle cars know-how but little to zero financial knowledge, is on the lookout for someone who will help him turn his falling business into a money making machine. That’s where you come in. New challenges, missions, story, mechanics, and business await. All of this available on [b]August 15th, 2024 for 16.99 USD[/b].

[previewyoutube=c0epi6-9upc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]VIP Update is here 🕵️[/h2]

That’s right! From now on a VIP customer will visit your station from time to time. Basically, you wanna serve him just like a normal client but there is a catch – serve him properly a couple of times in a row to receive a special bonus which will boost all of the sources of your income. However, there is one difference that distinguishes VIP customer from a normal one and that is its own cooldown. As soon as you serve the VIP client you’re gonna have to wait a couple of minutes until he comes back again, so you don’t have to stand on your tiptoes 24/7. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b7a9b0250770df2a5d64547ce1aeb1003098c3c6.jpg[/img]
[i]wake up gas jockey, we have a VIP customer to serve[/i]

[h2]Transfer between DLCs 👀[/h2]

From now on you can freely move between maps if you happen to own a particular DLC. Right now you can transfer between Tidal Wave and Route 66 but we’re planning to expand this feature for a Shady Deals map as well. If you want to transfer your character to a different map all you need to do is simple interaction with the sign post below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/fd163cc24f31069ff308b5fb0a90dec21fcec7c3.jpg[/img]

With this update we’re also introducing a brand-new feature called passive income. The idea is simple – if you’ve unlocked different maps (in this case Tidal Wave and Route 66) they can basically profit from each other. The amount received is calculated based on the average income of your Costs and Revenues from the last seven days on the given map. In other words – you need to spend at least seven days on a particular map. Otherwise the system won’t be able to calculate how much passive income you should get. You can delve into all of the necessary statistics in the section in the Economy Tab called “Passive Income”. As always – I’m counting on your feedback, folks! 

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s gonna be it for today! So, how do you like our little surprise? Feedback is much appreciated so go now and enjoy a fresh update. I can’t wait to see your comments regarding both the trailer and VIP update, so do not let me down, okay? And last but not least for all of the things related to Gas Station Simulator and upcoming DLC, stick with us and consider adding the game to your wishlist 🙇Until the next devlog!
