notes.title: Crane & Crusher: The Heart of the Junkyard 🏗️ + ⚙️ = ❤️
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1][/b]

Welcome to another Gas Station Simulator – Car Junkyard DLC development sneak peek. In our previous one, we’ve delved a little bit into the whole customization thing, so if you somehow missed it, you can freely check it right now by clicking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620?emclan=103582791465284088&emgid=6361977949043829057]this link.[/url]

Today we shift our focus from customization to some of the core mechanics of the DLC which is operating crane and shredder. Apart from that, we’re more than happy to finally share our brand-new key art for the DLC – Not gonna lie, our 2D art team did an astonishing job with that one. Without further ado, let the game begin! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/bfd3169d4241d7ffa8bded6f54778917aefaa2a0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Art 🎨[/h2]

I honestly don’t think there is a better way to kick things off than showing you our official key art for the Car Junkyard DLC. As always I’d love to hear your feedback so you know what to do, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8270779acd352ebb54df1ceaf62ddea341c5f507.jpg[/img]

[h2]Crane & Crusher: The Heart of the Junkyard ❤️‍🔥[/h2]

One of the most critical additions in this DLC is the introduction of the Crane and Crusher structures. These features are integral to managing your junkyard effectively and are available from the very start of the game.

[h3]The Crane 🏗️[/h3]

The Crane is your main tool for handling car wrecks. It allows you to attach and transport wrecks either to the Shredder for processing or to the Junkyard Workshop for further work. It actually works in the similar way to Towy from the Airstrip DLC, so I assume some of you might already have some expertise in controlling the crane. Check it out below and let us know what you think in the comments down below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/62e8b806f29b4a8940dda9bea05d522684126db1.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Crusher ⚙️[/h3]

The Crusher is designed to handle car wrecks which will no longer be of any use. This wide machine crushes the wreck with the enormous force of powerful presses. All that remains of the wreck is... a small compressed cube flying out of the back of the machine. When you'll hear the clank of that metal, you won't necessarily want to save every wreck at all costs...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/242afb4686d8d4e67487844be6a3558b8a537459.jpg[/img]

[h2]Wrecks 🚗[/h2]

Wrecks are one of the key parts of the Car Junkyard DLC. When these wrecks arrive at your junkyard, they bring with them the potential for profit and discovery. You can choose to crush them for immediate money or take your time to extract interesting parts from them. These parts can be used to assemble your own cars later on, so depending on what you currently need, you’ll have to choose wisely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ed902bd5945a5ca59abe2ed1a4920b68141d5010.jpg[/img] 

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s gonna be it for today’s update. So, how do you like it? What do you think about these features? What would you like to see next? Are there any other things that we should consider with this DLC? I’m gonna be looking for your answers in the comments, so you know the drill. Last but not least, if you want to stay in the loop of everything Car Junkyard DLC make sure to add it to your wishlist 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782920/Gas_Station_Simulator__Car_Junkyard_DLC/

P.S While you’re waiting for the Car Junkyard DLC release and spending countless hours looking for some fantastic games to play, we have a recommendation for you. We’ve teamed up with some fine folks from Movie Games and we’ve managed to create a great bundle for ya all. If you’re looking for an awesome deal (pun intended) you can kill two birds with one stone and get Drug Dealer Simulator 2 with Gas Station Simulator – isn’t that cool? 😎

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42222/Gas_Dealer_Package/

notes.title: Lottery Machine enters the stage with a new Gas Station Simulator update🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

I hope you had a fantastic weekend and you’ve managed to charge up your batteries to face the challenges that await you this week. After our Friday’s update regarding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/4161967536312550892]Car Junkyard DLC[/url] it’s a high time for a little surprise for Gas Station Simulator. Today, I’d like to walk you through another update that in fact is already available for you to download and includes a brand-new money/popularity making machine – lottery. Wanna hear more about it? Let’s not waste any more time, and dive right into the details 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/03dd7bc0d26ea4bc3d365b3e1f0dfeda91ed6675.png[/img]

[h2]Everything you need to know about the lottery update 🎟️[/h2]

First and foremost, let’s talk about how to access the lottery machine and where it’s gonna be placed on your thriving gas station empire. So, in order to access and acquire a lottery machine you need to open your PC and direct to the “Features” tab. There you’ll be able to purchase the machine and start using it to make some additional profit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6a2111084e65abc668f90c99c1158dcf8737a0b4.jpg[/img]

Now, let’s talk a little bit about how it’s gonna work in the game. Before you begin earning some money from the lottery, you need to set up a prize according to your liking. The higher the prize, the better the reward will be (higher ticket price along with the greater popularity growth). Basically the biggest risk is that even if the percentage of winning is 0.2% there is still a slight chance that someone will win the prize before earning exceeds your prize pool. Nothing ventured, nothing gained, right?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/0bae0cbe5e1f261ced8022545304d51cd01e3c3f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today. Let me know in the comments down below what you think about the update. We’ll be monitoring the comments and your feedback throughout the week, so don’t hesitate to let us know your thoughts. And last but not least, I’d like to announce that we’ve teamed up with some fine folks over Sparrow Night and came up with a fresh Gas & News bundle. If running only one empire wasn't a big challenge for you, try your hand at building and managing your editorial line of your dreams. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41895/Gas__News_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32134/Gas_Station_DLC_Pack/

notes.title: Capture your best moments in Gas Station Simulator thanks to the Photo Mode 📷
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

I hope you had a fantastic time over Easter and you’ve managed to charge up your batteries, so you can easily face the challenges awaiting you. As for us, we’ve been working tirelessly to bring you guys some new features to the Gas Station Simulator that will enhance your gameplay experience even further. 

In today’s announcement, I’d like to shed some light into one particular feature that will allow you to capture some stunning views that you might spot while running your gas station empire. The best thing? It’s already available, so without wasting too much time, let’s talk about the Photo Mode 📷

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/cdbea424b7d736464e9fba53593da435fd9adb02.jpg[/img]

[h2]What kind of features does Photo Mode have?[/h2]

If you’ve ever wanted to stop time for a while and capture your favorite moments at your gas station without irritating UI – it’s all possible now thanks to the Photo Mode. You can freely adjust a plethora of things – [b]from FOV, brightness, and saturation, to focus distance, sharpness[/b], and there is even an option to add some cool looking frames to your photos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5261a17181d14d918a209b938c4db862583393b6.gif[/img]

Oh… Did I mention that you have a [b]special photo album[/b] where you can keep your photos in one place? How cool is that! Check it out for yourself and let us know what you think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c71d5fa3f49cf44d2bee5c12999078fdf26fd84f.gif[/img]

[h2]Celebrate the release of Photo Mode with our giveaway 🏆[/h2]

To celebrate the release of Photo Mode we’ve prepared a brand-new giveaway for you. I’d like to highly encourage you to participate, because the prize is definitely worth a try. All you need to do is [url=https://gleam.io/DQ0tb/who-doesnt-love-some-free-cash-]click this link[/url] and you’ll then proceed to the giveaway page. The rest is simple – complete as many tasks as you can, and may the luck be with you. 

[url=https://gleam.io/DQ0tb/who-doesnt-love-some-free-cash-][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/613c68f6e79cc5d6a04c8c5b5dcaee47edce5a5d.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Some improvements & Bugfixes 🐛[/h2]

Just before we finish, our team has also managed to fix a couple of those pesky issues that you guys have encountered recently. Read the whole thing below. 

[h3]Gas Station Simulator[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur when an employee starts a new shift
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur during the loading of a game
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur during saving Employees data
[*] Fixed an issue related to car pathing while loading an old save
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur during workshop minigame
[*] Workshop employees now have correct rotation
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur during swapping walls with Hammer Tool
[/list]

[h3]Party Time DLC[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash related to Ice Cream minigame
[/list]

[h3]Tidal Wave DLC[/h3]

[list]
[*] There is no longer a possibility to unpack the delivery boat if it's waiting in the queue
[*] NPCs should no longer get stuck in the shower
[*] Fixed a crash that might occur during fuel delivery
[*] Various minor UI visual fixes
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that is the end of today’s announcement. As per usual, let me know in the comments down below what you guys think about Photo Mode. I cannot wait to see some of your stunning photos from Gas Station Simulator and its DLCs. Unleash your creativity and don’t hesitate to share those wonderful screenshots with us. You can freely do so on our [url=https://discord.gg/EZdPPkWc]discord server[/url] for example on which I’d like to invite all of you right now. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782920/Gas_Station_Simulator__Car_Junkyard_DLC/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/

notes.title: Customizing your station becomes much easier thanks to Snap to Grid 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to another Gas Station Simulator update. Recently we’ve shed some light about the long-awaited Shady Deals DLC, so if you would like to dive into the details, you can check it out by clicking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/4065130635420574849]this link[/url]. 

Today, I’ve got some exciting stuff to share – the much-anticipated “Snap to Grid” feature is right now available for you, which means customizing your station will become much, much easier and more precise from now on. With a snap to grid you can adjust the angle of rotation and a grid size. Check the gifs below to see how it looks in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/80f2696b17c82e9ef412405708135e03181ba672.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b2ad97c397830dbc8a4101ea500252162234feb7.gif[/img]

Additionally, a bunch of fixes found its way into today’s update. We’ve issued some of the most pesky ones, so running your gas station empire should be much smoother and better from now on. Check the full patch notes below, to see what else you can expect.👇

[h2]Bugfixes 🐛[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a rare issue that crashed the game after loading a save
[*]Fixed an issue related to invoking multiple airplane fueling minigames while spamming the left mouse button action
[*]Firing employee widget should now properly close when using Esc
[*]Fixed an issue related to placeholder tutorials showing up when playing with only Airstrip DLC installed 
[*]Product previews related to items carried by planes now work correctly
[*]The quest for serving party bus customers now ends correctly if we use the Reset Button
[*]Some of the popups messages related to employee management were adjusted
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today, gas jockeys! Let me know in the comments down below what you think about today’s update. Also, if you spot any issues that stop you from progressing further, don’t hesitate to share such information as soon as possible under this announcement, discussion forum, on our official discord server which I highly advise you to join. Have a wonderful weekend and until the next devlog.

notes.title: Economy Update is coming this week! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! 🚉[/h1] 

Welcome to the first announcement in 2024! I hope you had a wonderful break and you’ve managed to greet 2024 with a blast. In today’s devlog, I’m thrilled to bring you some information about the upcoming update for Gas Station Simulator - the Economy Update! This update aims to make the in-game economic system more dynamic, providing a more realistic and engaging financial challenge for you folks! Let’s roll!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/4b146d02c7e77a5c3ae8f380852639adfe27d0ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is an Economy Update? 🤔[/h2]

An Economy Update involves a comprehensive rebalancing of various in-game elements related to finances, prices, and economic interactions. In this update, we've focused on refining the pricing structures for gas. Additionally, we've introduced new features like a dynamic gas pricing curve, delivery fees, and expanded loan options to add depth and complexity to the game's economic landscape.

[h3]Gas Pricing ⛽[/h3]

With this update, we’re finally adding a visible dynamic pricing curve for gas. This curve will reflect recent price trends, providing you with a more realistic and dynamic market to navigate. Keep an eye on the gas ordering interface to stay informed about the current pricing trends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/26b1535234589d3911008e6f60d07965dff0e0db.jpg[/img]

[h3]Delivery Fees 💰[/h3]

Starting with this update, deliveries will incur a fee if the order amount is less than $150. The delivery cost will be a flat $25.

[h3]Loans 🤝[/h3]

To cater to the diverse financial needs, we've introduced additional loan options. Each loan comes as usual, with a specified amount to borrow and a set time frame for repayment:
[list]
[i][*]$100 - $200 (8 minutes to pay back)
[*]$250 - $450 (12 minutes to pay back)
[*]$500 - $800 (16 minutes to pay back)
[*]$1000 - $1400 (24 minutes to pay back)
[*]$2000 - $2500 (36 minutes to pay back)[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/a8c2cac22b70dbdfea199143e41d4e58f2fc075b.jpg[/img]

The initial design of the loan system remains unchanged. In the unfortunate event of non-repayment, the biker will make an appearance to collect the player's movable properties with a value similar to the outstanding loan. In other words - think twice before you decide to get yourself a loan – If I were you, I wouldn’t like to meet the biker face to face while taking my stuff away. 

[h2]New Widgets 👀[/h2]

[h3]Storehouse Inventory Widget 📦[/h3]

In response to player feedback, we're introducing a handy new widget that displays the current inventory count in your storehouse. Keep track of your stocked items efficiently and plan your restocking strategies accordingly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6e1914cfaeaed7fb387690f2599a721b9840c05e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Financial Overview Widget 📊[/h3]

Stay on top of your financial game with the new Financial Overview Widget. This feature provides a detailed breakdown of your spendings and earnings, helping you manage your station's finances more effectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/0b8be3f8cd6bf56e84820bb74f5fb1f178d6d7e0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Pricing Adjustments 💲[/h2]

[h3]Client Purchases 🙋[/h3]

As part of the Economy Update, we've meticulously reviewed and adjusted the prices for items that customers can purchase at your station. 

[h3]Workshop Prices 🛠️[/h3]

Speaking about adjusting prices – we’ve also extended our scrutiny to the workshop. Prices for both items and services in the workshop have been fine-tuned to reflect a more realistic economic model. 

[h2]Last week of our giveaway! 💥[/h2]

Before we wrap up, don't forget about our ongoing giveaway! There's just one week left to participate and stand a chance to win an exclusive opportunity to appear in our games. If you somehow didn’t participate yet, make sure to [url=https://gleam.io/7xmtx/drago-entertainment-giveaway-]click this link[/url] or the image below. 

[url=https://gleam.io/7xmtx/drago-entertainment-giveaway-][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/523688ff0065e0f702c4996771141f8e041f6977.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today! Make sure to leave your feedback regarding the Economy Update in the comments section below or hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/8JXySJ9YeY]official discord server[/url]. Your feedback and support is invaluable for us, so thank you very much for every single comment. Until the next devlog!

P.S Oh I totally forgot to announce when the update is gonna be live. Sorry for that, folks! I’m happy to share that the Economy Update will be live on Friday! As soon as the update goes live, we’re gonna make sure to officially let you know via Steam, Discord, and our social media channels.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992100/Gas_Station_Simulator__Shady_Deals_DLC/?l=polish

~Your humble marketing guy – Sewek

notes.title: Gas Station Simulator – Tidal Wave DLC devlog #2 – Mortal Business 👦
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

It’s Sewek again! Welcome to another Tidal Wave DLC related devlog. In today’s development update, I’m gonna delve into the Mortal Business system that’s gonna be crucial in our upcoming DLC. Get ready to dive deep into the world of business mortality, aquatic adventures, and, of course, the notorious Chunchumanchu god. If you somehow missed the first Tidal Wave DLC devlog, you can still read it by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/3783647417799157085]clicking this link[/url]. But enough talkin’ Let's explore the key features of the Mortal Business system 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e0f0ceb1ed82ba5ca150a156d5473e750b596e8b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mortal Business System ☠️[/h2]

In the Tidal Wave DLC, we're introducing a brand-new Mortal Business system. Every time a client meets an unfortunate end in the ocean, the wrath of Chunchumanchu god will intensify. You might be thinking right now – OK, but what am I supposed to do with that? Well, actually more than you might have expected. First of all, it’s your job to keep the rental equipment in the best quality possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8a89843d5ee736d95ce57c916f2fb2b52b000532.jpg[/img]

If you neglect taking care of the gear, it’s gonna lose its durability which might lead to a devastating accident with deadly consequences. You will need to balance profit-making with ethical decisions to avoid invoking the wrath of the mighty god. It's a dynamic twist that adds a layer of strategic depth to your Gas Station management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/cefa538830c9b1f7df2643fec0345acbeb02b1bf.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Shark 🦈[/h3]

Did you miss Dennis? If so, I have some good news for ya! He will also be a part of the Tidal Wave DLC…But just in a different form to say the least. In our brand-new DLC your main antagonist is gonna be a devastating shark lurking in the ocean. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8a3ec2df8a2b4793c2c260596c195df5ed8c6cee.gif[/img]

You will need to fend him off from time to time to keep your customers safe while they venture into the ocean. To do so, we're giving you a means of power this time! A handy hand cannon at your disposal 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/3fdf5654e4b1511469468d791b201f9c77375c5c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Scuba Diving 🤿[/h3]

For the first time ever, your Gas Station will extend its services to the open waters. Clients can now rent windsurfing boats and scuba diving gear, offering a refreshing break from the routine fueling and cashier duties. But every adventure has its own dangers, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5b1a951382c0d7dac9d6b63abc2d7a37e493eaf4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Quest System Rework is here! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to another Gas Station Simulator development update. Today I have the privilege to announce that the long-awaited quest system rework update is finally here. It’s probably one of the most important updates in the history of Gas Station Simulator, so don’t hesitate and go check it out. 

[h2]What exactly Quest System Rework does?[/h2]

But what exactly will this rework do – you might think. Don’t worry – I’ve got you covered. So, for those of you who are not familiar with the Airstrip DLC – its storyline starts as soon as you upgrade your station to the 3rd level and you hire your very first employee. Before the quest system rework, you’d need to complete dozens of Airstrip DLC quests, while those related to the base game were hidden until you’ve finished the DLC ones. With the quest system rework you now have the possibility to choose in which particular order you’d like to do them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/d0a5e5a452c99220c845455909dd9014dc7ae4e6.jpg[/img]

Let me give you an example – Let’s start from the point where you’ve upgraded your station already to the 3rd level and Airstrip DLC quests come in. You can do them if you want, but if you feel like you need more money, employees, popularity or whatever you need basically, you can always follow the main ones without worrying much about the Airstrip DLC. In other words – until you feel like you’re ready to go with Airstrip DLC, you can freely focus on growing your gas station empire. And yes – you can complete for example three Airstrip-related quests and come back again to the base game, leaving Airstrip for the later. 

Oh… And one more thing: As soon as you download the update make sure to check out if everything works as intended – especially saves. If by any means you’ll encounter any issues, make sure to leave your comment under this announcement or contact us via email here: support@drago-entertainment.com

[h2]Tidal Wave DLC – teaser trailer reminder🏝️[/h2]

[previewyoutube=8tV7FROi3Bo;full][/previewyoutube]

If somehow some of you might have missed the teaser for the Tidal Wave DLC, worry no more! You can have a look at it right now and share your thoughts in the comments below. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600880/Gas_Station_Simulator__Tidal_Wave_DLC/

[h2]You can still sign-up for playtests🎮[/h2]

Just a quick reminder that you can still sign-up to become our playtester. If you still haven’t done it yet, you can do so by clicking [url=https://drago-entertainment.com/playtest/]this link[/url] or the image below, and fill the form that you will find there. After that, we’ll carefully analyze every single application and we’ll contact those chosen with further information. 

[url=https://drago-entertainment.com/playtest/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/1e5728beedef444196f152c23b1bb6f038dd0587.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What about the Economy Update?🤔[/h2]

So far we've introduced to you an Employee Update and Quest System rework is finally here, so you might be thinking what's gonna be next? Worry no more, folks, since I've got you covered. From now on, we'd like to put emphasis on some changes related to in-game economy. We won't spoil anything just yet, but let me assure you – it's coming sooner rather than later. As always – let us know in the comments what do you think about it. 

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today, folks! Hope you’ve enjoyed our little teaser. Don’t hesitate to throw your feedback at us in the comments section below regarding the quest system update, our upcoming DLCs including Tidal Wave and Shady Deals, or basically everything Gas Station Sim. Enjoy the update and until the next devlog! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992100/Gas_Station_Simulator__Shady_Deals_DLC/

[i]~Your humble marketing guy – Sewek[/i]

notes.content:
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Not gonna lie – the excitement is getting off the charts as we’re thrilled to announce that [b]the Employee Update is finally here![/b] I understand that you might be busy playing the new update right now, so I won’t take much time from you today. However, I’d highly advise you to stick with me ‘till the end as I have the privilege to reveal what is coming to the Gas Station Simulator universe. So let’s see what I’ve got for you this time. 

[h2]Employee Update 🧑‍💼[/h2]

With the much anticipated Employee Update, you’ll now have the possibility to hire [b]two additional employees, schedule everyone’s work[/b] thanks to day/night shifts, [b]prioritize their tasks[/b], and pay them their rightful wages – all of this within one tab accessible via the computer. How convenient is that? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/068a89f60015c47b0cfe7cc4842bb16093938133.jpg[/img]

[h2]Employee Update patch notes📒[/h2]

In addition to all the employee-related stuff, I’ve also managed to sneak around our office and steal the patch notes from the dev team. Just don’t tell them that I just did that, okay? 

[h3]Gas Station Simulator⛽[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with a certain car causing traffic jam near spawning points
[*]Fixed an issue that caused drivers to choose the wrong path while driving a car out of a parking lot
[*]Fixed an issue that caused small car “Maluch” to pick up wrong path when driving away from fuel pump
[*]Car spawn points are no longer visible

[*]Party Bus Customers no longer have stretched tongues
[*]Talking to the employee no longer prevents him from continuing his work
[*]Customers will now pick the correct way into the station if some decorations are placed near the entrance
[/list]

[h3]Party Time🥳[/h3]
[list]

[h3]Gas Station Simulator – Airstrip DLC✈️[/h3]
[list]
[*]Broom tutorial no longer blocks the view in Marshall Wands minigame
[*]Fixed an issue that caused blockade of inputs while clicking on Marshall Wands

[h2]Gas Station Simulator – Tidal Wave DLC is coming🌊 [/h2]

Yes, you read that right – the whole DRAGO entertainment team is thrilled to announce the new addition to the Gas Station Simulator universe. Gas Jockeys, welcome the Tidal Wave DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/a2ea454097ea21f84338d41d033a1f80b7dd726f.png[/img]

[h2]Key features 🔑[/h2]

This unique gauge serves as a direct reflection of the god's mood. As time passes or customer dissatisfaction mounts, Chunchumanchu's anger will grow, bringing unforeseen challenges to your island oasis.

[*][b]Keep up the harmony[/b] – Balance the island's precarious harmony by performing sacred offerings at the altar. Toss coconuts, shells, or other items into the caldera to appease Chunchumanchu. Each action carries a distinct impact on lowering the god's anger and preserving your business.

[*][b]Expand in the way you want to[/b] – In Tidal Wave, players will have the unique opportunity to freely expand their Gas Station empire. No objective limitations – just you and your money. 

[*][b]Face the consequences of your actions[/b] – Fail to maintain the god's favor, and prepare for a cataclysmic eruption that transforms your paradise into a fiery hellscape. Business will grind to a halt and customers will flee in terror. Can you keep Chunchumanchu at bay?

[*][b]Mortal Business Logic[/b] – Equip your Gas Station and other structures wisely. Neglecting proper maintenance can lead to accidents, resulting in the escalation of Chunchumanchu's anger. Monitor equipment durability carefully to minimize risks.

[*][b]Engage with a variety of different activities[/b] – Diversify your repertoire by providing scuba diving and surfing rentals. But beware, equipment neglect can lead to accidents that will directly affect the Volcano meter's volatile mood swings.

[*][b]Confront threats that lurk in the ocean[/b] – A lurking shark adds an element of danger as it occasionally targets your customers. Quickly react by throwing objects or deploying underwater mines to protect your patrons and profits.

[*][b]And much, much more[/b] – Fuel jet skis, receive cargo by boat, and confront unexpected weather phenomena such as gray sandstorms and thunders, making each day on the island a new challenge.

notes.title: Manage your way up to the top - Scheduling System Devlog
notes.content:
[i]Hey there![/i]

We’re here to make your life in Dust Bowl much easier - managing a whole gas empire would be difficult without help of your employees, wouldn’t it? Well, the news is that [b]with the upcoming Employee Update things are about to get much smoother [/b]- today we’re talking about a whole new Scheduling System. 

[b]Grab yourself some coffee or tea, and let’s roll![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b15ebc4eb55bd024ec4360a5238c12af96c1983a.png[/img]

[b]UI-wise we decided to make it clear and simple - no excel spreadsheets, no meetings that could’ve been an e-mail, no corporate atmosphere. Just you, your employees, and your task manager. [/b]

Starting with the left side, you can access all the info about your employee - it’s important to get to know them better, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5f4265f321a4cdedaa84cc0ee398d4185c60bbe4.gif[/img]

[b]Other than their backstory, you can also access your employee’s skill levels here - how convenient! [/b]

Next up we have those two buttons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c5ff5349b07f5b44ba8d61feb738a1560743ac67.png[/img]

[b]The orange one sends your employee back to their camper[/b] - let’s say Riccardo get’s stuck. What do I do? I just press the button resetting his position, so he can get back to work. 
[b]The red button can be used to fire your employee whenever you’re not happy with them[/b] - damn, let’s hope you won’t have to use it. 

And here’s our favorite part of the whole system - task management:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5b9a763dd49d1b036b388d84e268679733c838b5.png[/img]

[b]You can task your employee with two different actions at a time - the upper one will have a higher priority, which means the lower one will be executed once the employee is done with the other activity. 
[/b]
In this example Riccardo will be fueling cars whenever there’s a client waiting to get it done - if nobody’s waiting, he’ll be repairing cars instead. 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] You can see a little checkbox next to the tasks - it allows you to activate and deactivate actions. If both of the actions are inactive, the employee will return to their camper. Deactivating the action with the higher priority automatically deactivates the other activity as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/186311bb277bc4ba0b3df3dff5b1ceb9648e8eaa.png[/img]

Now, for the finance-management part, we have employee’s salary. [b]Whenever they are doing their job, they accumulate a certain amount of money they will have to be paid whenever they go on a break in order for them to come back to work. [/b]
The yellow button with a star means you can give your employee a bonus that will [b]replenish their stamina bar and allow them to work overhours. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/32de8fb7e82bae6de58c265590123e023e9cb2fa.png[/img]

And last, but not least - [b]we have two different shifts now! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ad9c0c72c647445778a67e75c8d9d9bec76b2b9e.png[/img]

[b]Here you can choose whether the employee is gonna work night shifts or day shifts on your station[/b] (or both if you give them a bonus salary).

notes.title: The Chronicles of Dennis - From Gas Station Simulator to Food Truck Simulator
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Gas Jockeys![/b]

In our last short announcement, we’ve introduced to you some of our other titles that we currently have in our portfolio. Today, however, we’d like to focus a little bit more on one peculiar character that everyone loves (right?) – Dennis. We'll dive into the intriguing background story, so buckle up, grab your favorite snack, and embark with us on a journey as we explore the transformation of Dennis from a young troublemaker at the gas station to an entrepreneur with his own food truck business in the city.

[h2]The Mischievous Young Boy at the Gas Station[/h2]

In the early days of Gas Station Simulator, players encountered a mischievous young boy named Dennis. He was a clever troublemaker who enjoyed playing pranks on the station's staff. Denis always had a way of making the gas station a chaotic but fun place. Well… Depending on what fun means to you, of course. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e26d5c1a35c311db086fc0ce51174d86cb6faa7f.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Farewell to the Gas Station[/h2]

After spending a significant amount of time at the station, Dennis realized that he wanted something more out of life. The gas station environment, while familiar and comfortable, couldn't quench his thirst for new experiences and opportunities. He wanted to explore the bustling city, broaden his horizons, and seek out a different path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/54496b09af8fa68a2f2178c0a632b89fe8e0f50f.jpg[/img]

[h2]An Ambitious Venture[/h2]

Determined to find his own place in the world, Dennis bid farewell to the gas station and embarked on a thrilling adventure to the city. Leaving behind memories of his playful shenanigans, he sought to establish himself in a brand new career.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/d39683e4c96f731b9626ba224074809751665605.jpg[/img]

[h2]Food Truck Aspiration[/h2]

In the heart of the city, Dennis stumbled upon a vibrant street food scene. The tantalizing aromas, the lively atmosphere, and the creative freedom of food trucks ignited a spark within him. He knew he had found his calling. He answered a call from inside and decided to start his own food truck business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b3729f6a9c6b71149b6ea9cdb42fee60085d0c5c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Food Truck Simulator[/h2]

In Food Truck Simulator, players now encounter an older, more mature Dennis, the proud owner of his thriving Food Truck business. He has built a reputation for serving delectable and innovative dishes from his food truck, capturing the hearts and taste buds of the city's food enthusiasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/bd6325551f2f730ff8cf6167c6b3a14eeb9639f6.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Beloved Figure[/h2]

As players progress through the game, they encounter Dennis a couple of times. However, he is different right now – rather than being a pain in the ass, he’s now your rival in the food truck underworld. He even decided to burn your Food Truck in order to achieve his goals of becoming more popular than you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/7f59ad55c6c0ef17b2433554e70c48ed32665564.jpg[/img]

[h2]Food Truck Simulator update[/h2]

With that story finished, we right now would like to let you know about update for the Food Truck Simulator. We’ve managed to adjust a sushi mini-game, so for those of you who found it a little bit challenging it should be way easier right now to complete it. Additionally, sushi minigame buttons are now rebindable. THAT'S RIGHT! That means you should be able to play it on any keyboard you want!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28634/Petrol_Food_Bundle/

notes.title: Summer Update is here! ☀️🔥
notes.content:
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Summer has hit us with its full glory, but fortunately it didn't stop us from working hard on delivering another chunky update for Gas Station Simulator as well as Airstrip DLC. As always, we'd like to hear your thoughts regarding the update, so make sure to leave your answers in the comment section below. 

Before we delve into the fixes, we'd like to announce that currently we're running a giveaway which can be accessed by clicking [url=https://gleam.io/JBUVm/car-for-sale-simulator-x-gas-station-simulator-giveaway]this link[/url] or the image below. Go and check it for yourself, folks!

[url=https://gleam.io/JBUVm/car-for-sale-simulator-x-gas-station-simulator-giveaway][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ef2a399675f3a240291a6fdc7af792384cf5fa90.png[/img]
[/url]
Now, let's dive into details for today's update, shall we? We've created a separate list for the Gas Station Simulator and Airstrip DLC, just to make things a little more clear for you. 

[h2]Gas Station Simulator⛽[/h2]

[list]
[*] Pumps area is now more accessible due to changes of collision to some assets
[*] Cleaning sand piles with Rudy now works correctly
[*] The low-pressure texture in Car Wash now matches with state of the water
[*] Dropped items textures no longer get affected by floor dirt
[*] Some of the missing textures were added
[*] The spark plug in the workshop minigame is now displayed in the correct position
[*] [b]Fixed an issue that caused cars to flip on the spawn in some scenarios[/b]
[*] An exploit that provided an infinite amount of items while closing and reopening the station was fixed
[*] Fixed cars now drive away automatically if the game with a fully repaired car is loaded
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented fixing some car parts after loading a game in some scenarios
[*] Some LODs were corrected
[*] Grass in some areas was adjusted to be more fitting
[*] The garbage service now picks up a bigger pile of trash from containers
[*] Saving and loading no longer makes spark plug bigger every time
[*] Using UFO reset button no longer leaves items in the cash register's basket
[/list]

[h2]Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC✈️[/h2]

[list]
[*] Now it is impossible to remove Tequilla for Joe's quest in specific scenarios
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented further progress while starting the Airstrip campaign during the car wash questline
[*] Now it is possible to pass Move random object to Airport Storage with any item
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed to deny plane when it shouldn’t be possible
[*] Information about denying a plane will no longer be stuck on a screen in some cases
[*] Some of the items categories were adjusted
[*] Some levitating objects were positioned correctly 
[*] The amount of fuel during the plane fueling minigame is now correctly displayed
[*] Fixed an issue that caused pilots from both airstrips to leave at the same time
[*] Timer for arriving planes no longer resets after loading a game in some scenarios
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date📰[/h2]

And that would be it for today, folks! We hope that the fixes we've just provided will make your gameplay experience even more enjoyable. However, if you still encounter any weird things during your gameplay session, don't hesitate to let us know about it. Your constant support and feedback push us forward on our development journey, and we're so thankful for that. Have a wonderful day and the weekend ahead! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32176/Gas_Station_Fly_Me_to_the_Moon_Bundle/

~DRAGO entertainment team

notes.title: Airstrip DLC development update #4 – Trading🤝
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/9201b67d2e4dbb1e58fa23aaf49e6c35cf521f57.jpg[/img]
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Welcome to another devlog in which we’ll do our best to familiarize you with our upcoming DLC. We’ve already shared some details about Joe and Towy, so if you missed the previous devlogs, you can check them here ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/3720575453111590058]Meet Joe[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/3720575537114694980]Say hi to Towy[/url]). Today we’re going to shed some light on the trading aspect that is coming with the Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC. Without further ado, let’s get some trades going! 

[h2]Trading System 💰[/h2]

Occasionally, your Airstrip will have the unique opportunity to welcome country-related planes. Each plane will have a different set of products at its disposal, so you'll be able to get some unique items each time they arrive at your airstrip. To make a deal, you’ll need to make sure that your stock is full of high-quality items, as this will boost your chances for a successful trade. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/d72ef8064a91cb322c391227ec55e37ad2b024f4.gif[/img]

Your chances of success are indicated by a circle that, depending on the item's quality and the amount you want to sell or buy, will change accordingly. It’s totally up to you whether you want to try your luck or not – the rewards might be worth a try, but you have to keep in mind that the pilot might not want to give you a second chance. However, some tricks will aid you or make your life a little harder as you progress through the game. 

[h2]Boosts 📈 & Impediments📉[/h2]

Boosts are randomly generated events that create additional opportunities for the player to get a particular item at a preferential price. They can appear both on the players' and pilots' sides, but there is no possibility that they will show up on both sides at the same time. There is only one exception to that rule, but we’ll leave it for you to discover it when the [b]Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC releases on April 28th, 2023![/b]

On the other hand, you’ll also encounter some obstacles along your trading journey. While boosts will significantly help you, the impediments are designed to make the gameplay more challenging. 

[h2]Card System 💳[/h2]

To make trading a little easier, we’re adding some active cards that you’ll be able to get if you complete a specific set of tasks in the game. These might be upgrading a particular building or completing a certain amount of trades in the game. There will be four of them for you to collect, and you can already check what their purpose is. 

[h1]COGENCY[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/80092d3ce75fca2e14289c8ad8974fbdfb7294dd.png[/img][h1]EXTRA TIME[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ae05e9aa079ab38975be34f17722a6ea03ecf7bb.png[/img]
[h1]POWER OF CALM[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/758a6bad10058fec2e1f1f04d655a6a9ae5756c1.png[/img]
[h1]EXPRESSION OF GRATITUDE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/bd7202a9032242f20afe5c80bbdc5220f2a6f93e.png[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date[/h2]

And we’ve come to an end, fellow jockeys! We hope that you’ve enjoyed our little trading showcase, and we’ll be glad to see your opinions, suggestions, and ideas in the comment section below. Please, keep in mind that everything you’ve seen is still work-in-progress stuff, and we’re doing our best to polish it as much as we can till the release. If you don’t want to miss any news regarding the game or DLC, consider adding it to your wishlist.

notes.title: Airstrip DLC Development Update #2 – Meet Joe👨‍✈️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/9a46b5a4b794698f43adcdb588d90d8213e84464.jpg[/img]
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

We're back with another devlog that will familiarize you with the Gas Station Simulator – Airstrip DLC. Recently, we've shared some brief information about the game, but as we've read through the comments, we've realized that some of you don't know what the DLC is going to be about. Thus, in this development update, we'll share some more information about the main character in the game, his background story, and his role in the game. 

Before we move further, we'd like to invite you to our next devlog that will be live on Saturday (we're going to show some new mechanics, so you don't want to miss that one 🔥). Without further ado, let's jump into the main topic of today's devlog! 🤩

[h2]Joe's background story 📝[/h2]

As we announced in the last devlog, Airstrip DLC will have its own, unique campaign that you'll be able to complete. Along with that, we felt that there is a need to add a brand-new character that is strictly related to the DLC but also is familiar with the area where Gas Station Simulator takes place. As a result, we've created Joe – a US Air Force pilot, and war veteran, who suffers from PTSD due to his traumatic experiences in the past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/72ca35d7d50052ef13e7bf505fb4b71661083432.jpg[/img]

At first, he might be unpleasant, but as you progress through the game, you'll realize that he is a warm, honest, and most importantly trustworthy man, who you can rely on. However, the question is – how did Joe end up here? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/4553c5cb77574ce8305fbe50943ec8e327599ff6.png[/img]

Fortunately for him, one of his old friends has offered him a share in a business he has been running for a while. Both of them decided to take the path of smugglers – they were responsible for transferring goods to the US from Central and South America. Somehow, Joe became fascinated by Latin American culture and decided to focus his efforts on finding the legendary Aztec and Montezuma gold.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e58bb77059aab1c4c6a9cfe6d0feab8d304493b9.png[/img]

[h2]Joe's role in the game✈️[/h2]

As we said at the beginning, Joe is the main character of the DLC. Apart from that, he will also introduce you to a new area of the game. In addition, you'll be able to interact with Joe, and by doing so, you'll get the chance to upgrade the Airstrip area and unlock new tools that will be useful throughout the rest of the game. 

[h2]The new set of animations 💥[/h2]

As we're getting closer and closer to the release date, we'd like to present to you a new set of animations that we've been recently working on. These are still work-in-progress stuff, but you can already get a glimpse of how Joe looks in the game. Oh, and feel free to share your thoughts regarding the animations and Joe himself. 

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8ff27671d65b535a15d547c786fb46aa54230ecb.gif[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/dc4f1bddf111d631ae33c88f5e6687982937cd64.gif[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6b2d0e3b4edc19f34e65c47f921650406f9b3e5e.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Towy's Sneak Peek👀[/h2]

Surprise, surprise! From today, you might notice a new truck that has been added (but you can't control it just yet) to the base game. This is Towy – a new vehicle that will be helpful in the Airstrip DLC. We'll dive into details on Saturday, so stay tuned for that. We're curious if you can guess in which cases you'll need to use our new friend, so feel free to leave your answers in the comments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/944a811ef2efd85b40885f787e262c8af26ac72a.png[/img]

[h2]Party Bus Optimization 🚌[/h2]

As we've read your comments, we also realized that many of you've had some performance issues during the Party Bus event. Fortunately, we can finally say that this has been fixed, and you shouldn't have any problems with that from now on. Additionally, we're still working on fixes and making the game better in general, so your feedback is much appreciated. 🙏

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And we've come to an end, fellow Jockeys! ⛽ We hope that you've enjoyed the stuff that we showed today. We cannot wait to see your feedback, so feel free to drop it in the comments below. If you don't want to miss any future updates regarding the Airstrip DLC, consider adding it to your wishlist if you haven't done it yet 🙇

notes.title: Valentine's Update is here!❤️🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b26dd201a8899fb68491a945cf39dbf5e19ef544.jpg[/img]

Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Last week, we shared with you a little sneak peek from the upcoming Valentine's Update. Fortunately, the update is already live just before the weekend, so you can create the station of your dreams. 

We've also managed to fix some of the issues that players have encountered. Last but not least, we heard your voices and with the Valentine's Update it is now possible to [b]exit the painting mini-game[/b]. Check the full patch notes below for more details:⬇️


[h3]Valentine’s Content❤️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds a Valentine’s themed Landmark.
[*] Adds 3 Valentine’s themed wallpapers.
[*] Adds 10 Valentine’s themed decals.
[*] For the Can Touch This DLC this update also adds Valentine’s themed wall, doors, 2 types of windows and roof.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements⚒️[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s now possible to exit the painting mini-game.
[*] Rotating standing decorations/shelves should now be smoother and we reduced the speed while at it. You can now hold the SHIFT-key while rotating to speed it up.
[*] You can now hold the Left Mouse Button on the plus button while ordering to quickly add multiple products/car parts/ice creams.
[*] You can now save up to three order lists per shop type. They will be available after loading a game. In addition, there is an option to use the previous order that is remembered until loading a game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes🐛[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ice Cream mini-game: customers will no longer unnecessary react to the bell after being served.
[*] Ice Cream mini-game: fixes a bug that made replacing empty containers impossible.
[*] Fixes the issue that caused trash to fall under the floor.
[*] Fixes an issue that allowed hanging decorations and shelves on occupied spots after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixes a bug that caused decorations and shelves to disappear while aiming at some walls.
[*] The Ferris Wheel should now work correctly.
[*] Information about items stolen by the Biker (after not paying a loan) will now be correctly displayed.
[*] The Party Bus (Party Time DLC) should no longer get stuck on a fence.
[*] Wheels in the Workshop should no longer fall out of your hands.
[*] AZERTY keyboard now works correctly with keybindings.
[/list]

And that's it, fellow jockeys! Don't forget to share your Valentine's-styled stations with us on our discord or via Steam forums. We'll take a closer look into them, and some of them might ended up on our social media channels. Don't forget to follow us there so you can stay up-to-date with any news.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/91e0d91c99101d3920665c7389b0b406145ec9a8.jpg[/img]

The Christmas Content update for Gas Station Simulator features specific content for Christmas along some bug fixes and optimizations. And if you look around, you might already find the spot where the airstrip will be. You can also expect the new pre-recorded stream that should be live later today, so stay tuned. Without further ado, let's get the Christmas started!🎄

[list]
[*] Adds Christmas themed wallpapers.
[*] Adds a Christmas themed landmark.
[*] Adds new decals to the game, most of which are Christmas themed.
[*] Customers now have Christmas hats (can be disabled in Settings if that’s too much Christmas for you). [i]Pssst... I advise to check Gustav as well.[/i]

notes.title: Update #8 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/063c1681b53344e1533af0823d527c594e69ed4a.jpg[/img]

Update #8 comes with some significant GPU performance improvements that should increase FPS across the board and a series of bug fixes.

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have optimized a vast amount of assets in order to significantly lower the number of primitives displayed by GPU at once and thus increase the frame rate.
[*] We further optimized instancing of products displayed on shelves to allow better performance inside the gas station.
[*] Several objects and the landscape had their dynamic shadows adjusted.
[*] Culling has seem some serious work to further improve frame rates all around. Due to quite large changes made in this area, on some systems or configurations there might be some visual glitches or some in-game objects might appear later than intended. This is something we are currently working on and will improve in another update later this month.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue that caused the game to crash when painting pillars in the warehouse.
[*] Fixes an issue that could potentially cause the game to crash during autosaving under certain conditions.
[*] Fixes an issue that prevented the triangle parts under gable roofs to be painted.
[*] Fixes a crash that occurred when the painting service was removing Denis's art.
[*] Fixes a bug that caused the game to freeze after playing for a very long time.
[*] Fixes a bug with RC Car track 1 which caused players to receive an infinite amount of money while falling off the map.
[*] Fixes a bug that refreshed the number of available lockpicks when canceling a mini-game.
[*] The Painter’s Truck now has the steering wheel in its correct place.
[*] Warehouse is again correctly robbed when you leave the door open.
[*] Fixes an issue that prevents the shelves in the Workshop to display their names correctly and showing “None" instead.
[*] Removes the unknown green light near the Dust Bowl sign.
[*] Fixes the spelling for Cigarette Stands.
[*] Fixes a bug that caused services and deliveries to be duplicated when calling the UFO.
[*] Fixes fueling cars with pumps not assigned to their station correctly.
[*] Scratch doctor is now correctly used after fixing a car’s door.
[*] Spark plugs dropped on the ground will no longer increase in size.
[*] Workshop notifications will now correctly remove only one entry when customers get annoyed by waiting too long rather than clearing all workshop notifications.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #7 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/063c1681b53344e1533af0823d527c594e69ed4a.jpg[/img]

Update #7 is here! While the major goal of this update has been stability and especially CPU performance, we also added some new features and general gameplay improvements.
The CPU focus allows us to further increase frame rates going forward.
We also moved to an updated version of the game’s engine and switched to DirectX 12 which in itself should provide even further improvements.

This update also introduces some changes to the AI. In order to avoid problems with traffic or customers, it might be necessary to reset the traffic using the Big Red Button at the Dust Bowl sign when you first start the game after the update.


[h3]Features & Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now a management tab on the PC that allows you to open/close all areas of the gas station. This allows you better control of how busy you want things to be at any given time.
[*] A new caravan section has been added allowing you to hire an additional employee for a total of 6 employees helping you out on the gas station.
[*] Enjoy even more freedom to customize your station thanks to the new Landmark list which allows you to hide any large decorations around the station.
[*] A new landmark has been added. It’s a wreck of an old food truck.
[*] A new unique NPC has been added. Clara is a reference to our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck Simulator[/url] where she plays a major role.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sprint is finally here. Serve your gas station customers even more efficiently thanks to faster movement by using the SHIFT button.
[*] A new AI task randomization system has been implemented that should provide a bit more randomness in customer arrival orders to make it feel a bit less superficial.
[*] The thresholds for popularity levels have been significantly lowered across the board. We also added 9 new popularity levels in preparation for the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126170/Gas_Station_Simulator__Party_Time_DLC/]Party Time DLC[/url] that will further improve the popularity situation many players complained about.
[*] Fuel Capacity saving/loading should now always be working properly. In certain cases when loading a saved game you could lose the fuel in the truck that was about to deliver it to your gas station.
[*] Warehouse Capacity should now be calculated correctly when saving/loading games. In some conditions they did previously show the wrong values.
[/list]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “artworks” created by Dennis will now be destroyed after customizing a new wall with the hammer tool and paying the price.
[*] Tools in hand should no longer wrongly rotate under certain conditions.
[*] Fixes an issue that caused customers to "drive in air" while returning to their vehicle.
[/list]

[h3]Employees[/h3]
[list]
[*] Employees should now be smarter when cleaning and will no longer go for the same trash items or objects all the time.
[*] You can hire one more employee for up to 6 total.
[*] The scanner and baskets will now appear when an employee is serving customers at the cash register.
[/list]

[h3]Stability[/h3]
We did quite a lot of small fixes in many areas when it comes to stability and you should see a significant improvement in that area. As for the bigger fixes, this update does:
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue within the physics subsystem that was responsible for a significant amount of crashes, especially in later stages of the game.
[*] Fixes various memory issues within the UI that would eventually lead to the game crashing. 
[*] Fixes another nasty memory leak when invoking the in-game menu (ESC) on system with 8GB of RAM or less.
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gas Station Simulator has been moved to a new engine version and now by default supports DirectX 12. This helps with some of the performance improvements. Should your GPU not support DirectX 12, you can still run the game in DirectX 11 mode by launching the game with the optional parameter -d3d11. 
[*] Switching to the new engine also allowed us to use various package and asset optimizations which resulted in reducing the size game assets take on your SDD/HDD (about 3-5GB depending on DLCs). Storage space saving however were not our primary consideration, but the fact that the less storage space game assets take, the less time it takes to load them.
[*] This update also features a series of optimizations and improvements across the board when it comes to CPU, GPU and memory usage with gains up to 40%.
[*] We greatly optimized all physics systems in the game so that they’re now a lot more efficient when performing calculations on the CPU.
[*] Many of the gameplay related calculations have been reworked and more things are loaded and handles asynchronously now. This should result in less hitches and smoother overall gameplay performance.
[*] Car Wash related calculations were rewritten for better performance and strain the CPU a lot less now. Car Wash related game logic and calculations take about 90% less CPU resources now.
[*] VFX and Lighting systems has seen major improvements to avoid a situation when in certain conditions those system would cause high performance costs over time on the entire level.
[*] Optimized the lighting system and settings to consume less resources in general.
[*] Optimized the character animation system to costume less resources as well. This should help with performance especially in later stages of the game.
[*] Certain heavy textures were downsampled to further speed up loading times. These alone should decrease loading time by about 10-15%.
[*] LODs on most vehicles have been improved to look better at closer distances or lower settings.
[*] LODs for characters have been reworked to reduce the amount of weird clipping at lower settings.
[*] LODs for most objects in the game world has been improved upon to further improve GPU performance.
[*] Many optimizations to quest condition checking have been made. Cases where certain objects (like: the grandfather clock from the beginning of the game) when not removed could keep checking overlaps for the remainder of the game causing a minor drop in performance. While each drop on its own was indeed minor, they could add up which would make a noticeable difference especially on lower specs systems.
[/list]

[h3]Other Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Discord link in the main menu should work again allowing you to join our Discord community.
[*] Minor translation fixes in various languages.
[/list]

[h3]Can Touch This DLC[/h3]
[list]
[*] New roof selections have been added to allow you better match roofs with walls.
[/list]

We are very interested how the fixes and especially performance improvements are working for you. Please let us know. And while you do that, we continue working on update #8 that will focus mostly on GPU improvements.

notes.title: Managing Crucial Aspects
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/450031e3a02457e7a002462ffe3069a41c284ed9.jpg[/img]

Whether your business is handling or running four wheels or running on four wheels, there are a few basic rules to follow. When you master these common factors, you will become really a business shark in an ocean of opportunities. Let's analyze two economic activities that may become yours even today: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/]Gas Station[/url]. 

[h3]Renown[/h3]
Fame has different appearances and in Gas Station Simulator we like to call it "popularity". If an adventure on Route 66 is still ahead of you, popularity is a system that tracks feedback from your customers. Do not exceed the required amount of fuel while fulfilling the order. Check out each product carefully and do not scatter them on the floor. Take care of the gas station so that it is clean and its shelves are not empty. These and many other activities contribute to increased popularity, which means higher traffic, the possibility of further expanding and developing the gas station and unique visual rewards. For those who are struggling to reach the maximum popularity level, we hear you! We are working on a new way to increase popularity to make leveling more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f21b9cefc2d1d79f4434bacc75a79d4280962c00.jpg[/img]

For [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck Simulator[/url], based on the experience and feedback in Gas Station Simulator, we have created a new system called  “prestige” that approaches this topic slightly differently. There is nothing more sensitive than a customer with an empty belly, and as a chef and salesman you will meet many of them. Be careful because such a customer might be a ticking bomb that will damage your prestige when exploding. How to avoid it? Feed them properly. Keep an eye on the ingredients and don't make them wait too long. Take care of cleanliness! Nobody wants to eat a grilled burger that's wrapped in burnt fat. If you manage to do it, it will open up a whole host of new opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/1413f6765a67eb9326be89cdda6f483e01cfe561.jpg[/img]

[h3]Time[/h3]
If you thought you would have peace of mind at a gas station in the middle of nowhere, then you are almost right. The business beginnings are usually slow, and later on you can either take a break by closing the gas station or get help by hiring employees. Nevertheless, once you spread your wings and start offering fuel, a cool drink or a bathroom as the only place within dozens of miles, don't be surprised when a wave of customers floods you. May you be prepared for this in advance and have a warehouse full of products and tanks full of fuel. Time is not your ally, so keep an eye on it.
In Food Truck Simulator, time management begins in the garage. Plan a route, analyze all strategic places, and when you are ready, start the engine and show off with your driving skills. If you manage to get to the supply store on time before the competition, you will get a better offer. Be late and pay full price like any other. The next stop? The selling point where the time and mass of hungry customers stand against your kitchen under your command.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6cbdd52502c4de4ffafa88c2d538216e8390b97b.jpg[/img]
	
[h3]Progress[/h3]
	This point applies to both your business and you personally. Let's start with the Food Truck. Traveling through the corners of the city, makes you discover new locations that will provide a greater business range. You meet new people, thanks to whom you will expand your service scope. Over time, your vehicle will become a better mobile kitchen, and you will become a better driver which will allow you to get to further places faster. However, you can also focus on any single selling point. Focus on your favorite type of kitchen, which will please both you and the consumer. Some say that a good cook is not one who has trained 10,000 dishes, but one who practiced a dish  10,000 times. 
	And how to manage this in a desert? Las Vegas and Dubai were also built on empty sand. So remember the day you wake up for the first time as the owner of this not very spectacular abandoned gas station. Think of it a month later as you enter a huge and refurbished facility. Recall the initial silence when you hear the clamor of constant engines and people around you. When you go inside the workshop to save a customer's vacation or use the car wash to make sure someone's date goes well, think of the piles of sand that stood where these structures are now. The future is in your hands.

notes.title: What are we working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/09ffe1705a39cbf9f23d0ae54a4f89532067dc99.png[/img]

Time for a small preview of an upcoming update to Gas Station Simulator.
Despite Food Truck Simulator ramping up to its release in September and our Winter Survival entering Early Access soon after, Gas Station Simulator is still very high on the team’s priority list and we are working on new content and optimisations for while now. We reached a point where are pretty confident what will make its way into Update #7 of the game and that is a good point in time to let you know at least about some of those things. And we do have nice mix of things planed for you :)


[h2]Stability & Performance[/h2]
Aside from various fixes, especially those related to random crash issues, we continued the work from Update #4 and major optimisation overhauls. We tackled both CPU and GPU optimisations as well as physics related performance issues. Those combined should greatly improve the performance of the game especially on medium and high spec systems.

[h3]CPU Optimisations[/h3]
While the game isn’t really bottlenecked by the CPU in general, we addressed a lot of instances where the game on occasions got severely bottlenecked. Just for a moment or two, but that in turn caused the GPU performance to falter and then the recovery phase from those performance dips wasn’t short either. We rewrote a lot of code, especially in areas where the CPU is constantly kept busy to make some breathing room for the performance spikes that will occur no matter what - especially in the later stages of the game. 

Depending on the system and CPU, we freed up even [b]as much as 40%[/b] of CPU resources which is quite massive. This will not only result in overall better performance and more stable FPS, but also alleviate most of the massive performance spikes.

[h3]GPU Optimisations[/h3]
With the optimisation on the CPU side, we are now seeing much more stable GPU performance. This in turn allows us to optimise GPU even more, since the performance spikes caused by the CPU are dealt with. This is still ongoing and while we are not certain that all the optimisations we planned in this area will make it into the upcoming Update #7, a lot of them will. 

GPU performance will also benefit from another source. We are internally working on a native version of Gas Station Simulator for Macs and especially the changes required for Apple’s own silicon (M1/M2) are also beneficial performance-wise for the PC version of the game - especially on the low end of the machine spectrum. So when it comes to GPU performance, there will be something for every system tier.


[h2]New Features[/h2]
While Update #7 is mostly about optimisations and stability of the game, there will also be new things when it comes to content. Here are some of the highlights you can look forward to:

[list]
[*] An additional employee to help around the gas station.
[*] Open and close areas of the gas station separately.
[*] Remote accessing to the PC.
[*] New boosts for popularity levels.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/908afe6bb7be9419d1a9e48541e156345adc28ed.jpg[/img]

Yes, you will be able to not only access the PC inside the gas station from anyplace with a tablet like device, but you will be finally able to open or close each of the parking spots separately (which in turn are responsible for the customer influx at the cash register or the toilets), the car wash, fuel pumps (also separately) or the work spots in the garage. 

We will give more details about the added features as we will be getting closer to the release of Update #7, but we hope what we already provided today enough for you to get a taste what’s coming and whet your appetite a little. Yes, the food pun is here for a reason as there will be some cool Food Truck Simulator related things that fit a gas station nicely added as well…

notes.title: Update #6 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/04f85eb0940d8d631d6b3a9f64b5212b4ca1af58.jpg[/img]

Update #6 is a larger update to the base game adding new features, some improvements as well as some fixes and optimizations. Below the most important changes.

[h2]New Features[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Wall Repaint Service has been added to the game and is available at gas station level 5. It allows you pay a painter to come the gas station and repaint the walls.
[*] Alien TR45H Eliminator Supreme has been added using alien technology to quickly remove trash and foot prints within its projectile range. Gas Station level 5 required.
[*] 3 new popularity levels are now achievable, with statue upgrades. To accompany them we also added 3 new songs to the game.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrades are now handled via a new tab in the PC called Upgrades. We improved on managing upgrades in general and added a tech tree to handle them.
[*] Delivery drivers (food/parts) now stay in the delivery truck so these can drive away quicker.
[*] The UI now shows how much of a product you already have when ordering.
[*] Big changes to decorations, especially their placement:
[*] Indoor decorations are now called Movables.
[*] Outdoor decorations are now calledLandmarks.
[*] All interactive decorations (basketball, RC Car) were moved to a new category: Interactive decorations.
[*] Small decorations around the gas station that were previously accessible from “Outdoor decorations” like benches, chairs, tables, ice machines etc. are now accessible from Movables and [b]are buyable in any amount[/b]. 
[*] Movables can now be placed outside the gas station (next to its walls) in a freeform way, rather than in pre-placed positions as before.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with employees getting stuck without a task after loading.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused employees to disappear from the Employee tab.
[*] Fixed an issue with wrongly showing the “full trash can”  notification while the trash can wasn't really full.
[*] Police cars no longer activate red/blue lights all the time.
[*] Interactions with the PC while holding any tool in hand are now disabled. This should prevent soft locks.
[*] Various other small bug fixes all across the game. 
[*] /EDIT: Resetting the excavator (Rudy) now also resets its sand status. This should get rid of the problem that you can't properly clean up stand as the game reports Rudy already caring sand and being unable to dump it.
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Screen Space Global Illumination is now a graphic setting. Setting it to OFF (now by default off) will slightly improve performance. /EDIT: while the performance gains on Nvidia GPUs, especially GTX 1660 and RTX GPUs, are rather small, the performance [b]gains on Radeon GPUs are significant[/b].
[*] Various smaller lighting optimisation all across the game.
[/list]

Update #6 also comes in preparation for the game's first DLC to be released on May, 18th. If you haven't yet, add it to your wishlist: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940030/Gas_Station_Simulator__Can_Touch_This_DLC/

[/list]
Now, we promised a while ago to do something about keeping the gas station clean. While we tweaked the settings a bit in past updates, we were also working on a different approach. notes.title: First Gas Station Simulator DLC just 2 weeks away!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/10e4113574d32238a028cb1b02642a25e4f75a50.jpg[/img]

The Can Touch This DLC for Gas Station Simulator will be here in just two weeks so let’s have another look at its other features like rebuilding the gas station using the new hammer tool

[h3]HAMMER TOOL[/h3]
The [b]Hammer Tool[/b] is probably the biggest feature of the DLC. It is the go-to tool when it comes to customizing and oh boy can you customize now. You will be able to change [i]walls[/i] and [i]roofs[/i] and even go as far as change the location of [i]windows[/i]. 
Change the wooden paneling to bricks or stone, or change the appearance completely and make your roof flat which will make your station look completely different. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/953da4b405faa6991df58ad3a12a1d228811f52b.jpg[/img]

Windows are another interesting area to change things up. You can transform the interior by putting windows in other places that they are now and do the same with [i]doors[/i]. 

Combine it with the ability to [b]reposition the cash register[/b] you can make people stand where you want them to. Rotate and change the cash register’s position so you can add or remove windows or doors accordingly to even further influence the customer flow. Play around and make your ideas come to life and change everything there is.

Together with even more decorations in the DLC, you will be soon able to transform your station completely.


[h3]DECAL TOOL[/h3]
Another tool that is being added by the DLC is the [b]Decal Tool[/b]. It allows you to [i]spray paint[/i] practically anything anywhere to make your station look even more interesting and give it an even more personal touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f5ab45ca00c5b16f91cc9470d6c8b86ae63e2292.jpg[/img]

Choose from [i]dozens[/i] of presets ready for painting, select the tool and paint wherever you please. You can combine them as well so make some nice ornaments or keep them as they are, it’s up to you.


And there’s more, but we leave that for you to discover. Add the DLC to your wishlist to not miss it when it becomes available on May 11th 2022 for just $2.99:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940030/Gas_Station_Simulator__Can_Touch_This_DLC/

notes.title: First Gas Station Simulator DLC just one month away
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/edd5d7aa0d81b860027b43786479d24c6e6bb970.jpg[/img]
The Can Touch This DLC is undoubtedly getting closer to its release and we are bringing you more details and information about what you can expect from it once it is available to everyone!

The DLC isn't the only thing to look forward to, though. Accompanying the DLC will be a larger patch for the base game with some neat new features, but more about that next week. Now let's have a look at some of the many things the DLC will bring to the game.

[h3]MORE DECORATIONS[/h3]
We know that you gather (steal) a lot of decorations from people's trunks throughout the game or just buy them from the shop and they end up piling up in your inventory. So now, you can put all the excessive decoration to your warehouse loft.

You can now fully customize your living area, put out decoration, paint the walls and make it to your liking as you couldn’t before!

We’ve also added more decorations to the game in general, so you'll be able to choose from many new gems you’ll find in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/4a4fe467bb3f42d44f3f30f2012aaf6facfa64ae.jpg[/img]

This doesn’t only apply to the warehouse, but also to the workshop! Now you can finally change the look of the entire gas station premises.


[h3]EXTRA LEVELS[/h3]
We also know that this is something that every player went through when playing Gas Station Simulator. Reaching the final upgrade of each service and wanting more from it. From Gas Station to the latest Car Wash, we heard you and now we deliver.

With the upcoming DLC, you will be able to upgrade your Gas Station by 2 additional levels, Warehouse by 2 additional levels and Workshop by 1 more level. Those upgrades will of course come with appropriate perks such as more storage capacity and expansion of the building.

So remember, once the DLC is out on May 11th 2022, jump into the game, gather new decorations, earn more money and further expand your business with new mechanics and customization opportunities! And check back here soon for more insights into the DLC's content when we take a closer look at the new tools it will add to your menu and what cool things you can do with those.

Go ahead and add the DLC to your wishlist and get notified once it is available: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940030/Gas_Station_Simulator__Can_Touch_This_DLC/

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/13bd3022d419bbeddc7368f92cec803bb28a444d.jpg[/img]
This hot fix comes with various bug fixes, further performance improvements and fixes a crash related to the car wash.

[h3]Stability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Car Wash.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ordering over 1000 units of anything should now be possible (in some saves it was still prevented with the last fix).
[*] Loans will now correctly subtract money and remove popularity. Loans will also automatically be paid  off if you have enough money when the load period ends, rather than causing penalties.
[*] Using RMB when dropping cargo/boxes from delivery trucks will now always correctly return the box to the truck and the truck driver will no longer drive away with your goods if you do this on the last box of the set. 
[*] We've disabled the 'Lift Car' button during the initial tutorial 'Fix the Car' quest, and enabled ordering of car parts on this quest already. This change should significantly decrease any chance of getting locked out of progress.
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've optimized NPCs so they use less resources when idling. Further optimizations have been made to parked cars as well. At higher gas station levels the measured performance increase should be between 10-20% with recommended hardware or above. 
We're continuing to look at further optimizations on both CPU and GPU. 
[*] If you are noticing your performance dropping while washing cars, you can reduce the 'Effects' settings in Graphics Options to reduce the amount of particles that are being spawned and thus improve performance significantly.
[/list]
